programme.title: 熨斗家族
programme.desc: 一部以三代人在清廉洗衣店工作的家庭黑色喜劇。講述家人之間溫暖的感情和激烈的矛盾，是一部重新回顧現代社會「家庭」所具有的意義的作品.

programme.title: 1010 及 csl 呈獻: 730 玩返轉
programme.desc: 《730玩返轉》每晚為你帶來世界各地最新、最實用的旅遊情報，更有當地特色文化體驗、旅遊優惠資訊、以及旅遊達人的獨家分享。節目更與各地旅遊 KOL合作，希望為熱愛旅遊的香港人激發旅遊靈感，一起展開下一段未知的旅程啦.

programme.title: 細事都被你看透
programme.desc: 「網上起人底！係彰顯正義定陷人於不義？」「關愛座冇人座，你坐咗係咪錯？」網上熱話無奇不有，而且浮現了奇異現象；事件即使雞毛蒜皮，談論總是樂此不疲，題材趣怪貼地，回應自然舖天蓋地，隨時比大新聞更轟動。全新訪談節目，將會透過不同藝人、專家及講者，從多角度分析每日最hit話題，娛樂民生，衣食住行，無所不談。話題看似事不關己，實際影響其實殺到埋身！未雨绸缪，不再食花生，捍衛立場，舌劍唇槍，一於「小題大做」！濕碎嘢，認真傾，集大成，看世情.

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 流氓讀書會
programme.desc: 為了找證據，流氓讀書會成員潛入YB集團，與捐白幫展開鬥爭。而皮韓宇要求金順哲向羅太萬刑警作出虛假供詞。同時，期中考試終於開始，流氓讀書會成員必須提高成績，並至少上升十名，才能讓學校針對皮韓宇召開糾察委員會，他們都能成功嗎.

programme.title: foodpanda 呈獻: 存酒人
programme.desc: 監獄門外，燁仔跟阿當等待著BJ出獄，他是洗衣店少東，曾經也是市井酒吧的單口喜劇演員，因此跟市井眾人相熟，但大家並不知道他為什麼突然入獄，直到今次回來，從骨妹Abbie留給他的一支存酒，才得知入獄背後的畸戀故事.

programme.title: 咁先夠爽嘅Blue Girl呈獻: 四鏡大暴走
programme.desc: Ian和 Jer化身學徒跟把香港漫畫帶出國際的漫畫家Man僧學師，除了學習漫畫的基本技巧，二人在Man僧協助下，更把自己心愛的東西畫成壁畫。不少人喜愛在假期時逃離城市，走到郊外或離島去放鬆一下，而梅窩是其中一個熱門地點，踩踩單車、吃吃喝喝是常見的消閒活動，不過其實梅窩有不少大自然寶藏是鮮為人知。Stanley、Tiger今集將會與大家一齊深入山野跟農夫初體驗種植農作物，帶你看不一樣的梅窩.

programme.title: The Club 呈獻: 晚吹 - 怨女俱樂部

programme.desc: 講述了人工智慧的校巴卟卟與小朋友們前往火星，體驗新奇有趣的火星生活。小朋友們在火星收集蘑菇孢子，還在火星煮拉麵；他們見識到了不一樣的火星環境，如成分特殊的火星冰雪、脆弱的火星雲朵等。可是，火星自然環境過於特殊，小朋友們遇上了各種各樣的挑戰。這時，百變校巴就會立即出現，運用海量知識庫，和小朋友們共同解決問題，同時引導他們正確地認識和瞭解火星.

programme.title: 一周睇樓團
programme.desc: 為大家搜羅香港最新地產資訊，包括新盤介紹、二手放盤，以及特色的家居設計.

programme.title: 熨斗家族
programme.desc: 一部以三代人在清廉洗衣店工作的家庭黑色喜劇。講述家人之間溫暖的感情和激烈的矛盾，是一部重新回顧現代社會「家庭」所具有的意義的作品.

programme.title: 1010 及 csl 呈獻: 730 玩返轉
programme.desc: 《730玩返轉》每晚為你帶來世界各地最新、最實用的旅遊情報，更有當地特色文化體驗、旅遊優惠資訊、以及旅遊達人的獨家分享。節目更與各地旅遊 KOL合作，希望為熱愛旅遊的香港人激發旅遊靈感，一起展開下一段未知的旅程啦.

programme.title: 細事都被你看透
programme.desc: 「網上起人底！係彰顯正義定陷人於不義？」「關愛座冇人座，你坐咗係咪錯？」網上熱話無奇不有，而且浮現了奇異現象；事件即使雞毛蒜皮，談論總是樂此不疲，題材趣怪貼地，回應自然舖天蓋地，隨時比大新聞更轟動。全新訪談節目，將會透過不同藝人、專家及講者，從多角度分析每日最hit話題，娛樂民生，衣食住行，無所不談。話題看似事不關己，實際影響其實殺到埋身！未雨绸缪，不再食花生，捍衛立場，舌劍唇槍，一於「小題大做」！濕碎嘢，認真傾，集大成，看世情.

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 流氓讀書會
programme.desc: 糾察委員會要傳喚皮韓宇，韓宇的過去被揭露。韓宇想到一個計劃去阻止委員會召開，他製造假新聞，讓它在網上廣泛流傳。讀書會成員因此被誣陷為校內幫派，韓京為了保護學生，必須做出艱難的選擇.

programme.title: foodpanda 呈獻: 存酒人
programme.desc: 都市夫婦相處時間本來就不多，更何況養育住一個孩子。Amy 和 Steven因工作關係，一個日夜顛倒，一個經常不在港，見面時間不多，難得同日放假，可以享受二人世界，卻因孩子成長問題，甜蜜的溝通慢慢變成吵架。而給這對夫婦歸還存酒的燁仔，跟阿雪的感情有更進一步的發展.

programme.title: 咁先夠爽嘅Blue Girl呈獻: 四鏡大暴走
programme.desc: Ian、Jer則去了一間火鍋店品嚐現代港式火鍋和舊式七彩生鍋，到底舊式和新式火鍋的分別是什麼？哪一款更討兩位歡心？ 而上集Stanley、Tiger感受過舌尖上的梅窩，品嘗到絕頂鮮甜的香水蜜糖菠蘿後，今集二人親手發掘屬於梅窩的獨有色彩，一手一腳由採集到繪畫，畫出二人眼中的梅窩.

programme.title: The Club呈獻: 晚吹 - 男人亂講嘢
programme.desc: 世界覺醒（WOKE）了，每天都變得更像彩虹更有活力！從來以為自己是世界中心的男人卻呆站原地，眼光光看著日換星移宇宙萬變，看似固步自封但其實是有心無力！為舒緩廣大香港男士因為社會價值急速變化產生的焦慮和不安，三字頭的193（郭嘉駿）、四字頭的阿Thor（駱振偉）、以及五字頭的灘叔（鄒凱光）每星期都會圍爐亂講一通︰講男人求偶、男人私怨、男人包袱、男人浪漫、男人衰嘢、男人保健、男人蠢事——女觀眾或會恥笑，但男觀眾一定會感動大笑！就此召喚迷途的新時代男性，同《男人亂講嘢》一齊尋找當下世界觀，刷新固有價值觀，重塑男人三十、四十、五十路的人生觀！今次唔係要話人知男人曾經有幾威，而係要探討宜家男人有幾閉翳.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.

programme.title: The Club呈獻: 模範的士 2
programme.desc: 河俊得知自己的真實身份，以及教區長從小對他所做的一切..

programme.title: 旅巫 第12集 -地球之肺 - 亞馬遜雨林
programme.desc: 亞馬遜雨林，被稱為世界上最偉大嘅生命體現，廣闊無邊，埋藏無數秘密。Kanya與Yoshi進入亞馬遜的第一天，遇上外國旅人的他們問得到得知死藤水的消息嗎？找尋森林薩滿的路又將如何？一踏進原生森，竟然是危機四伏.

programme.desc: 六歲的女孩智率和明世一起在審訊室接受關於父親殺人案的審訊。她的母親聲稱智率是殺害她父親的人，因為她被惡靈附身，必須進行救贖儀式才能被使者拯救.

programme.title: 文藝誌

programme.title: 交易時段

programme.title: 唔試唔知份工好 -私家偵探
programme.desc: 做得私家偵探一定是去捉姦？非也！今次派出陳海寧到偵探公司學習做私家偵探，她會先去上堂了解私家偵探的基本知識，亦會落地實習一嘗跟蹤滋味。上完堂和實習跟縱，陳海寧更要做尋人個案，今次她要幫客人蘇先生尋找三十多年沒見的親生爸爸。她亦要做落地查證，去到蘇先生和爸爸曾經同住的舊址，看看有沒有再一步消息.

programme.title: 給香港的情書 第1集 -食玩貼紙設計師 - Brian Ng
programme.desc: 「食玩」兩字，是日文「食品玩具」的簡稱，通常指的是「附帶特殊贈品的食品」， 80年代開始食玩文化從日本帶到香港，現在變成了很多Kidult珍貴收藏。這一集食玩貼紙設計師Brian 將會分享他的私人貼紙收藏和設計，同時也分享自己的創作作為禮物送給香港.

programme.title: 1010 及 csl 呈獻: 730 玩返轉
programme.desc: 《730玩返轉》每晚為你帶來世界各地最新、最實用的旅遊情報，更有當地特色文化體驗、旅遊優惠資訊、以及旅遊達人的獨家分享。節目更與各地旅遊 KOL合作，希望為熱愛旅遊的香港人激發旅遊靈感，一起展開下一段未知的旅程啦.

programme.title: 野人老師
programme.desc: 家棟在危急之下找回意圖輕生的女同學，決定終止成功學訓練營，與 Billy 發生衝突。最終Billy 的吵鬧被李白一拳了結，但李白也因此再鬧出動手打人的醜聞。李白到五星補習社向 Billy 道歉，Billy 竟以直播方式侮辱李白；家棟終於拋開一切，向 Billy 揮出代表自己的一拳！Billy 事件意外地讓李白與滿兒的關係得以緩和，李白回到市區的家中探望兒子軒軒，卻發現軒軒變得越來越像以前的自己，希望趁著長假期將軒軒帶到大地小學小住.

programme.title: P1X3L 5G 上位計劃
programme.desc: 所謂天下無不散之筵席，我們終於要跟九展這個充滿回憶、希望、傳奇嘅地方講再見。九展曾經，誕生好多深入民心的節目，又孕育不少影視紅星。其中，當然包括明星中嘅逆行星，P1X3L 5G！因此，讓我們榨乾九展最後一滴價值，在這裡拍攝最後一個節目吧.

programme.title: 百變校巴
programme.sub-title: 火星沙畫 / 蘑菇基地
programme.desc: 講述了人工智慧的校巴卟卟與小朋友們前往火星，體驗新奇有趣的火星生活。小朋友們在火星收集蘑菇孢子，還在火星煮拉麵；他們見識到了不一樣的火星環境，如成分特殊的火星冰雪、脆弱的火星雲朵等。可是，火星自然環境過於特殊，小朋友們遇上了各種各樣的挑戰。這時，百變校巴就會立即出現，運用海量知識庫，和小朋友們共同解決問題，同時引導他們正確地認識和瞭解火星.

programme.title: 無敵鹿戰隊 第二季

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 流氓讀書會
programme.desc: 讀書會的成員知道皮韓宇一年前捲入的事件後，終於明白他為甚麼對學校的幫派如此執著。由於這可能會讓韓京有危險，成員們想出一個辦法來度過危機。韓京嘗試說服副校長支持她，但此時韓京卻遇到危險.

programme.title: foodpanda 呈獻: 存酒人
programme.desc: 總有些酒客叫人特別記得，車房老闆「啞仔」是其中一個，關於他的傳聞很多，鬼妹聽過他跟江湖女子Vic的故事。一切從Vic被江湖大佬東哥追殺開始，那天她躲進了陌生人啞仔的車房，啞仔可憐她的遭遇，因此收留她幾天。三日時間，同情發展成愛情，二人關係發展得風馳電掣，卻刻骨銘心，讓人記得一輩子.

programme.title: 咁先夠爽嘅Blue Girl呈獻: 四鏡大暴走
programme.desc: 男人的浪漫，除了是網絡流傳的豆腐火腩飯，想必離不開是豪車、名錶和美酒。今集Stanley、Tiger將會到訪香港第一間蒸餾氈酒廠，品味擁有香港風味的美酒，更一嚐「世一」調酒師的特調美酒。而Ian、Jer則到了一間著重「香港製造」的機械錶店，了解堅持本地製造的創業背後，二人更親自由零開始嘗試製作自己獨有的手錶.

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 晚吹 - 空肚講宵夜
programme.desc: 「抽水」大家會想起甚麼？被佔便宜？揶揄事件？還是天氣潮濕要抽水？Hailey 疑似被「抽水」經歷，是無心還是有意？BabyJohn 分享「抽水」慘痛經歷，屋企水浸原因究是廁所出事！阿祖分享曾在慶功宴見到有人飲醉抽人水！？想知更多？記得鎖定今集節目內容.

programme.title: 香港旅遊發展局呈獻: 香港跨年倒數
ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 時間來到2023年12月23日23:30，橫濱紀念公園。當勝呂寺誠司醒來時，他按著疼痛的頭，發現一個男人躺在他面前，頭部中槍，旁邊還放著一把手槍。就在這時，他的手機響起，有人告訴他立即離開該區。而且，電話另一邊的人告訴他一個小時後到某個地點.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版: 風起雲湧 小白的噼噼炸彈

programme.desc: 香港馬場是賽馬的地方，而在熊本的櫻花馬場，卻是古代日本養育戰馬的地方。不過時至今日，櫻花馬場已經變成觀光勝地。同時熊本的城彩苑可以品嚐傳統日本菜，又可在湧湧座觀看舞士舞蹈表演，更到地震後剛修復好的熊本城參觀.

programme.title: 究竟讀緊乜

programme.title: 食得怪 先好嗌

programme.title: 深宵閃避球
programme.desc: 外展社工楊琦（周家怡 飾）主理「深宵體育館」 計劃多年，一直鼓勵不願歸家的少女們，凌晨時份來到體育館做運動；無奈管理層突然出現人事變動，隨即面臨閉館危機… 在自稱資深教練的劉志聰（鄭伊健 飾）協助下，集合8位問題少女組成「粉青隊」，參加全港閃避球錦標賽：打贏就留館留人，打輸就執包袱走人！\r\n教練同8位隊員本身都各有煩惱，但呢一刻無得再退避，全情投入頂硬上，一齊領悟閃避球嘅真諦.

programme.sub-title: 鬼魂故事 / 非常麥都風格
programme.desc: 3021 年，在銀河系火星和木星之間的某個太空站上，8 歲的艾拉.懷達與她的朋友們一起踏上了激動人心的探索之旅。而且因為她們在太空中，所以有很多東西可以體驗，甚至有更多東西可以探索！艾拉的冒險不僅充滿刺激和樂趣，也總是充滿情感，讓她在每次意想不到的挑戰中發現並更加了解自己——她就跟她的名字一樣獨特：星際艾拉.

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去.

programme.desc: 「網上起人底！係彰顯正義定陷人於不義？」「關愛座冇人座，你坐咗係咪錯？」網上熱話無奇不有，而且浮現了奇異現象；事件即使雞毛蒜皮，談論總是樂此不疲，題材趣怪貼地，回應自然舖天蓋地，隨時比大新聞更轟動。全新訪談節目，將會透過不同藝人、專家及講者，從多角度分析每日最hit話題，娛樂民生，衣食住行，無所不談。話題看似事不關己，實際影響其實殺到埋身！未雨绸缪，不再食花生，捍衛立場，舌劍唇槍，一於「小題大做」！濕碎嘢，認真傾，集大成，看世情.(n)

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 鬼宮
programme.desc: 汝里試圖擺脫毀了她過去的龍神姜哲的陰影。尹甲的請求讓她走上了一條危險的道路.(n)

programme.title: foodpanda 呈獻: 存酒人
programme.desc: Jennie、阿寶和佩詩都是中學老師劉sir的學生，她們各自走到市井酒吧，要求拿走那支代表著她們與劉sir關係的存酒。在三人眼中，劉sir的形象各有不同，而愛、恨和愧疚背後，是三個難以釋懷的經歷，她們卻因劉sir突然離職而無法知曉真相。此外，Ann姐老公終於找上阿當，然而他的舉動並非如阿當想像那樣.(n)

programme.title: 咁先夠爽嘅Blue Girl呈獻: 四鏡大暴走
programme.desc: 今集四位兵分兩路，Jer和Tiger深入以殯儀業聞名的紅磡，拜訪堪稱年紀最輕的喃嘸師傅Oscar，究竟甚麼體驗等著他們呢？Ian、Stanley到訪一間保留了大排檔傳統菜式的餐廳，除了一嚐極具風味的美食外，更向餐廳師傅偷師學藝下廚，到底會是大顯身手，還是火燒廚房.(n)

programme.title: 晚吹 - 總有一瓣喺左近
programme.desc: 工廈近年成為不少年輕人的聚腳地。今集請來歌手Hysan分享他在工廈的靈異經歷。Hysan學生時期因為資金緊拙，租了一個曾發生事故的工廈單位創作音樂，搬進來後，眾人慢慢察覺到單位有點古怪，甚至在半夢半醒間看見女靈現身.(n)

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息.(n)

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 橫濱電視台的記者倉内桔梗接到命令，要播放聖誕特輯，而不是謀殺案，但她暗中準備與新人記者立葵査子一起報道這宗案件。桔梗得知疑犯是大學時代的熟人，於是拜訪了老師，並獲得了大學輟學生天樹勇太所居住的地址.(n)

programme.title: 我奪走了公爵的初夜
programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.

programme.title: 模範的士 2
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」替一群無法受到法律保護而滿腹冤屈的被害者們找回公理，以智慧懲罰罪犯的故事。​.

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.title: 我的女友比我帥
programme.desc: 金智恩因為外婆的家族史，一天醒來發現自己變成了男人 。震驚之下，她與男友朴允在見面，並向他解釋了自己的特殊情況。在朴允在的指導下，金智恩開始學習以男人的身份生活，並延續他們的愛情故事.

programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.title: 我的女友比我帥
programme.desc: 金智恩因為外婆的家族史，一天醒來發現自己變成了男人 。震驚之下，她與男友朴允在見面，並向他解釋了自己的特殊情況。在朴允在的指導下，金智恩開始學習以男人的身份生活，並延續他們的愛情故事.

programme.title: 我奪走了公爵的初夜
programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.

programme.title: 孝心的家各自為生
programme.desc: 李孝心是為家人打工謀生的體力勞動者，搬家工人。故事講述她試圖擺脫家庭的束縛，尋找獨立和幸福.

programme.title: 我的女友比我帥
programme.desc: 金智恩因為外婆的家族史，一天醒來發現自己變成了男人 。震驚之下，她與男友朴允在見面，並向他解釋了自己的特殊情況。在朴允在的指導下，金智恩開始學習以男人的身份生活，並延續他們的愛情故事.

programme.title: 私人銀行家
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突.

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.

programme.title: PICU Special 2024
programme.desc: 年輕小兒科醫生志子田武四郎在加入PICU一年後，克服了失去摯愛母親的痛苦和工作上的挫折，一點點成長蛻變成獨當一面的醫生。一天，一個垂危的弱小生命被帶進來PICU 小兒集中治療室.

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.title: 大奧
programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.title: 我奪走了公爵的初夜
programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.title: 我的女友比我帥
programme.desc: 金智恩因為外婆的家族史，一天醒來發現自己變成了男人 。震驚之下，她與男友朴允在見面，並向他解釋了自己的特殊情況。在朴允在的指導下，金智恩開始學習以男人的身份生活，並延續他們的愛情故事.

programme.title: 模範的士 2
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」替一群無法受到法律保護而滿腹冤屈的被害者們找回公理，以智慧懲罰罪犯的故事。​.

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.desc: 一位過著平凡生活的普通大學生一覺醒來發現自己穿越到最愛的歷史浪漫小說裡，成為了書中不知名的小配角「車善策」，她是一個富裕貴族家的女兒。才剛決定要靜靜的享受貴族生活的隔天，她就無意間與小說裡擁有超強佔有欲的男主角慶城君「李繁」共度一夜，並改變了小說的原著情節。「車善策」試圖讓「李繁」和小說中命中注定的女主角「趙恩愛」配對。但無論她如何努力，「李繁」對「車善策」日益增長的愛還是不斷地將他拉回她身邊.

programme.title: 模範的士 2
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」替一群無法受到法律保護而滿腹冤屈的被害者們找回公理，以智慧懲罰罪犯的故事。​.

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 念無雙
programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 原來我很愛你
programme.desc: 《原來我很愛你》該劇改編自木浮生同名小説，講述了桑無焉與偶像詞曲創作者蘇念衾兜兜轉轉的愛情故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 念無雙
programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 新生
programme.desc: 何珊被邀請到一座封閉的小島參加費可的追思會，她在那裡遇到四個互不相識的陌生人，他們被困在地下室里要求說出與費可相識的過程，然而他們發現每個人認識的費可都不一樣.

programme.title: 今夜一起為愛鼓掌
programme.desc: 佳晨（楊謹華 飾）是一名很會做愛的性治療師，但仍不知道怎麼愛人。圖書館員青語（Ella陳嘉樺 飾）有著外人羨慕的婚姻和工作，卻無法跟老公阿哲做愛。一個不能做愛的女人、和一個很會做愛的女人，當她們逐漸勇於面對自我，揭開過往傷疤；在探索性的旅程中，找到愛的救贖.

programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 新生
programme.desc: 何珊被邀請到一座封閉的小島參加費可的追思會，她在那裡遇到四個互不相識的陌生人，他們被困在地下室里要求說出與費可相識的過程，然而他們發現每個人認識的費可都不一樣.

programme.title: 仿生人間
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫.....

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 原來我很愛你
programme.desc: 《原來我很愛你》該劇改編自木浮生同名小説，講述了桑無焉與偶像詞曲創作者蘇念衾兜兜轉轉的愛情故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 念無雙
programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 原來我很愛你
programme.desc: 《原來我很愛你》該劇改編自木浮生同名小説，講述了桑無焉與偶像詞曲創作者蘇念衾兜兜轉轉的愛情故事.

programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(n)

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.(n)

programme.title: 原來我很愛你
programme.desc: 《原來我很愛你》該劇改編自木浮生同名小説，講述了桑無焉與偶像詞曲創作者蘇念衾兜兜轉轉的愛情故事.(n)

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(n)

programme.title: 王牌對王牌 第八季
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第九季
programme.sub-title: 極挑團全員變身葬愛家族
programme.desc: 在全新的征程上，由黃曉明、大張偉、龔俊、黃明昊、嚴浩翔、黃景瑜、賈乃亮、岳雲鵬組成「極挑團」；圍繞當下社會熱點，展開一場開放式的戶外項目及任務；一起領略自然，解鎖更多挑戰.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季
programme.sub-title: 騰格爾白舉綱跨時空對唱
programme.desc: 在音樂主題上再度突破，以「一路為伍，向生綻放」為主題，甄選了貼近生活的歌曲和作品，用歌聲傳遞正能量；邀請了A-Lin、大張偉、庾澄慶、馬嘉祺、光良、蘇慧玲、任賢齊、陳卓璇、曾比特、白舉綱、吳莫愁等老、中、青三代歌手，在全新升級的「盲選配對」模式中組合獻唱，在代際傳承、時代交融中突破自我，打造一場最溫暖、最動人的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.sub-title: 戀愛中使用交友軟件是背叛嗎
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 野挺有趣
programme.sub-title: 孟佳許佳琪跳多巴胺女團舞
programme.desc: 社區生活體驗真人秀；黃宗澤、陳卓璇、李雅娟、王勉、張嘉元、張小婉等嘉賓接受委托，化身為活動策劃團隊，通過改造場地、邀請遊客、開辦集會等方式，把裡予社區逐步構建成集藝術、環保、潮流為一體的青年文化聚集地；打造一場場「奇趣」的社交活動，呈現當代年輕人「野plus」般態度表達的綜藝盛宴.

programme.title: 有秘密的我們 第2季
programme.sub-title: 野外約會 奶狗弟弟變相表白
programme.desc: 以山野為背景，10位素人嘉賓都攜帶一個秘密進入「真相小屋」，這些秘密可能涉及過去的傷痛、未了的心願等，隨著節目推進逐漸揭曉；秘密成為推動他們情感發展的關鍵因素，也增加了未知性和驚喜感，並放棄了傳統戀綜依賴觀察室嘉賓或專家解析的模式，讓觀眾直接充當觀察者.

programme.title: 罪嫁
programme.desc: 尚書之女沈沅芷為戀人定罪，被迫嫁入侯府受盡樊星序報復。二人揭露顧恆遠陰謀後，又卷入叛國事件。兩人將計就計達成合作，在相處中消除誤會情愫漸生，誅殺叛徒，有情人終成眷屬.

programme.title: 說唱夢工廠
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星.

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 見證浪漫 偏愛島甜蜜日常
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.

programme.sub-title: 老歌新唱兩代人一起蹦
programme.desc: 五位全新的音樂人梁龍、胡夏、白舉綱、希林娜依·高、黃子弘凡以歌手形象反轉擔任Live House工作人員，以全新的姿態再度開啟這趟音樂旅程。同時，帶著全新口號「總有快樂發聲」，一起共同見證更多生活中的美好與驚喜.

programme.desc: 由孟非坐鎮主持的大型相親節目，男女雙方父母與子女一起同台相親，共同探討擇偶、戀愛、婚姻等問題，展現兩代人的婚戀觀，再創新型相親模式.(c)

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.sub-title: 心的連接才是最大的安全感
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.(c)

programme.title: 星廚駕到 第3季
programme.desc: 明星美食競技真人show，嘉賓包括佘詩曼、田亮、秦海璐、王琳、賈玲、何潔、郭麒麟和隋雨蒙。他們將迎接不同主題的美食挑戰，以美食傳遞愛，通過美食帶給觀眾正能量.(c)

programme.sub-title: 開啟商業對決 誰是訂單之王
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.(c)

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第九季
programme.sub-title: 黃曉明岳雲鵬被瓢爆頭
programme.desc: 在全新的征程上，由黃曉明、大張偉、龔俊、黃明昊、嚴浩翔、黃景瑜、賈乃亮、岳雲鵬組成「極挑團」；圍繞當下社會熱點，展開一場開放式的戶外項目及任務；一起領略自然，解鎖更多挑戰.(n)

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季
programme.sub-title: 杜德偉驚喜加盟再唱《情人
programme.desc: 在音樂主題上再度突破，以「一路為伍，向生綻放」為主題，甄選了貼近生活的歌曲和作品，用歌聲傳遞正能量；邀請了A-Lin、大張偉、庾澄慶、馬嘉祺、光良、蘇慧玲、任賢齊、陳卓璇、曾比特、白舉綱、吳莫愁等老、中、青三代歌手，在全新升級的「盲選配對」模式中組合獻唱，在代際傳承、時代交融中突破自我，打造一場最溫暖、最動人的音樂盛宴.(n)

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.(n)

programme.title: 野挺有趣
programme.desc: 社區生活體驗真人秀；黃宗澤、陳卓璇、李雅娟、王勉、張嘉元、張小婉等嘉賓接受委托，化身為活動策劃團隊，通過改造場地、邀請遊客、開辦集會等方式，把裡予社區逐步構建成集藝術、環保、潮流為一體的青年文化聚集地；打造一場場「奇趣」的社交活動，呈現當代年輕人「野plus」般態度表達的綜藝盛宴.(n)

programme.title: 罪嫁
programme.desc: 尚書之女沈沅芷為戀人定罪，被迫嫁入侯府受盡樊星序報復。二人揭露顧恆遠陰謀後，又卷入叛國事件。兩人將計就計達成合作，在相處中消除誤會情愫漸生，誅殺叛徒，有情人終成眷屬.(n)

programme.title: 橘祥如意
programme.desc: 講述了世代經營橘子產業的沈家老爺沈晏清與六弟沈晏洲同時愛上家境困頓的秀橘，為了延續沈家的香火，在大太太莊惠的安排下秀橘嫁給了沈晏清，於是四人之間開啟了一段愛恨痴纏的虐戀故事.(n)

programme.title: 味道 第三季
programme.desc: 以美食為介質的全新文化訪談類節目，每集邀請文化名人、名廚大師、外籍帥哥、直播網紅和民間饕客一同做客飯局，在品嚐民間美味的同時，分享人生故事.(n)

programme.title: 十天之後回到現實
programme.desc: 沉浸式生存闖關綜藝連續劇，邀請了吳奇隆、陳妍希、侯明昊、林更新、沈月等39位來自各行各業的高能闖關者，在真實城市中進行10天不間斷的全封閉生活，經歷腦力、體力、心理博弈、團隊協作等遊戲關卡挑戰，最終所有關卡通關，勝出的人成最後的大贏家.(n)

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.(n)

programme.desc: Elmo, Tamir, Charlie, Julia, and Cookie Monster are making self-portraits in the community garden with Kayla. Kayla guides them to look into the mirror and notice the beautiful things that make you, you! Everyone looks at themselves in the mirror and starts drawing what they see. They also learn their identity is about what you love to do. So, they add onto their self-portraits and then share their drawings with each other. Cookie Monster draws his blue fur, his googly eyes, and cookies. Charlie draws her blue eyes, curly blonde hair, tap shoes, and challah bread because it’s one of her favorite Jewish foods. Julia draws her straight hair, musical notes, paw prints, and her dog Rose. Elmo draws his red fur, orange nose, a piano, and watering a flower with Abby because being a kind neighbor is part of Elmo’s identity. Tamir draws his brown skin, coily hair, comic books, and some veggies as he loves gardening in the community garden. There are so many special things that make you, you.

programme.title: 惡靈戰警
programme.desc: Homicide detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of serial killer Edgar Reese. Soon after the execution, the killings start again, and they are very similar to Reese's style.(n)

programme.title: 超級壞蛋
programme.desc: Super villain Megamind’s (Will Ferrell) dreams have come true when he conquers Metro Man (Brad Pitt) but when a new villain (Jonah Hill) runs rampant, can Megamind save the day.(n)

programme.title: 不能說的秘密
programme.desc: A mysterious piano solo draws Lun's attention on his first day at new school. He meets the piano girl Yu, and they soon become intimate friends. But all in a sudden, Yu disappears..

programme.title: 片場職人 -吳君如
programme.desc: In the second part of the interview, Sandra Ng revisits some of her early iconic comedies and tells how the giddy on-screen persona was established turning her to stay on the path of a comedian. She also gives a peek into her inner world as a female creator, unveiling the true side of this highly influential comedy actress.

programme.title: 百年好合
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung (Louis Koo) is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May (Sammi Cheng). The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery (Li Bing-Bing) shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost'Heartbreak Sword Technique'..

programme.title: 當男人戀愛時
programme.desc: A-cheng is a rogue who relies on debt collection for living. He lives in the attic of a small barber shop managed by his elder brother. It's time for a 37-year-old adult to live on his own, but he always ignores all contempt from others. One day, he goes to the hospital to collect a debt from a creditor in coma, there he meets Hao-ting, daughter of the creditor. She is forced to sign a debt transferring contract without any complaint. Her silhouette of silently taking care of her father deeply attracts A-cheng, a guy who never had responsibility before. A-cheng clumsily draws a “graffiti contract” to offset Hao-ting's debts with walks and dinners as dating, even tries his best to manage the funeral for her father. Hao-ting feels touched by his behaviors and accepts his pursuit. Unexpectedly, a barter gambling takes away their future ruthlessly. A-cheng is not only imprisoned, also diagnosed with hemangioma. He has not much time left...At that moment, A-cheng finally understan.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：幽靈忍者珍風傳
programme.desc: One day, a woman named Chiyome Hesogakure visits the Nohara family with a 5-year-old child called Chinzo. Chiyome claims that she is the actual birth mother of Shinnosuke! But before Misae and Hiroshi figure out the truth, a group of mysterious ninjas come to the Nohara family and take Chiyome and Shinchan away to a Ninja Village! Chiyome tells Shinchan that there is powerful energy stored inside the Earth. To prevent energy loss from the 'Navel of the Earth', descendants of the Hesogakure block it with a pure gold plug by using 'Ninpo: The Art of Mononoke'. The Earth will wither, and the rotation will stop if it comes off! Can Shinchan protect the future of the Earth and the 'tomorrow' of his family.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -情陷「網」中人
programme.desc: Sandra Ng and MC (Cheung Tin Fu) grow a virtual romance in the film “Love Lies” which the script has revolved around online dating scam. What inspired the production team to make such a tale of love and deceit? And how the main cast of two initially unlikable people was chosen? The film director Ho Miu Ki and producer Chan Hing Kai are invited hereby to tell us more about this romantic comedy..

programme.title: 我談的那場戀愛
programme.desc: 'Love, once believed, is real.' Despite being swindled out of a large sum of money, the well-known gynecologist Yu still insisted that she was in love. Yu, who had been widowed for several years, met Joe, who was disguised as a middle-aged French petroleum engineer and widower, on a dating app, not knowing that he was part of an online scam group. Not only was Yu immersed in the online romance, but Joe also found pleasure and satisfaction in creating romantic experiences for Yu. Two initially unlikable people gradually changed through this online romance that began with deception.

programme.title: 冬日「動」起來: 鈴芽之旅
programme.desc: Suzume, a 17-year-old girl who lives in a quiet town in Kyushu, meets Souta, a young man looking for a door. Following Souta, Suzume finds an old door in the mountains and reaches out her hands towards the door as if pulled by something. This opened door will bring disaster; thus, Souta must travel around to lock the door to avoid disaster. But then, a mysterious kitten turns Souta into a broken wooden chair. To catch the kitten, Suzume and Souta follow it and travel from Kyushu to Tokyo. “Doors of disaster” begin to appear across Japan simultaneously, and Suzume needs to close and lock the doors one by one to stop the disasters. Unexpectedly, a forgotten truth is waiting for her.

programme.title: 竊聽風雲2
programme.desc: LAW Man-seng is one of the most reputable securities dealers in Hong Kong. One day, he drives his luxury sports car and notices that a car is tailing him. His car finally crashes and Law is sent to the hospital. At the hospital, he sees a police officer HO Chi-keung, and thinks the officer is here for the car accident. But Ho works for the Department of Homeland Security which is responsible for counter-terrorism. Ho has found some surveillance devices in the wreckage of Law's sports car which are for military use..

programme.title: 放‧逐
programme.desc: Two hit men from Hong Kong sent to take out a renegade member trying to turn over a new leaf with his wife and newborn baby. They soon find themselves in the throes of a dilemma when two of their former associates also show up, intent on thwarting them at every cost..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -打開世外大門
programme.desc: “Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.

programme.title: 喜馬拉亞星
programme.desc: Singh is borne and grown up in Himalayas and has reached the ultimate stage in Yoga. He goes to participate the India Beauty's husband-to-be contest. He meets the wanna-be-married Tally. Tally proposed to induce Singh to be a rotten, so India Beauty has a bad husband. Uncle Panic goes traveling to India with his two nephews. Uncle Brave who is one of the tourists has absolutely opposite character. Uncle Panic bumps into several India robbers who hypnotize him and was brought into the Journey Of Illusion by The Peacock..

programme.title: 假冒女團
programme.desc: Cercis Lui goes undercover in this lively comedy as an officer of the 'International Association for the Physical and Mental Health Development of Underage Boys and Girls” dedicated to protecting young boys and girls from being exploited in their pursuit of pop stardom. When tasked with taking down a shady talent show and its mastermind, Big Boss, Cercis must disguise himself as a woman to enter the competition. Only then can he get close enough to gather the evidence to take down the criminal ring. Joining this outlandish operation are Helianthus - an entertainment reporter, Circle O – a wannabe popstar, Lilium - a notorious artist and Oval O – cousin of Circle O from the US. But does this ragtag team have what it takes to triumph over the shady side of the business.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -拍戲4拍4
programme.desc: It took Band Four 8 years from sketch to a movie. Kay Tse and Teddy Robin, who played distant daughter and father in the movie, thought the characters were quite different from them in person, as they found themselves on beat in reality. Speaking of director Mo Lai Yan Chi, they each have a story with her to tell..

programme.title: 4拍4家族
programme.desc: “Band Four” is the story of Cat aspiring to make her mark on the global music stage, while contending with the haunting absence of her father, King, a guitarist who abandoned her and her mother two decades ago. Cat's life takes a dramatic turn when her mother succumbs to illness, and King unexpectedly appears at the funeral together with Matilda, Cat's previously unknown adolescent stepsister, further complicating Cat's ongoing struggle to raise her own 9-year-old son, Riley. Forced to live together in a crowded Hong Kong flat, the newly reunited family finds itself in a vortex of conflicting personalities, insecurities, and priorities. The family finds amidst this turmoil a common communication channel via music. Just as the familial bond begins to form through their shared musical language, both their bond and Band Four's survival are put to the test by a fresh set of unforeseen challenges.

programme.title: 長津湖之水門橋
programme.desc: During the second battle of the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea, the 9th Corps Command issues an order for the 7th Infantry Company to attack the Sumun Bridge. The 7th Company suffers a tough march to the Sumun Bridge. The soldiers are near their limits, every step forward in the midst of the harsh weather only means another great challenge to the body and mind..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: 那夜凌晨，我老公死極死唔去
programme.desc: So-hee is a newlywed with a seemingly perfect marriage. But one day, she suspects her husband Man-gil of cheating, and hires a private detective who finds out that her husband is not actually human. They also discover that he has already married several times, with all his ex-wives reported missing or dead. With the help of her school friends, So-hee tries to kill her husband, but he won't fall for her traps so easily... Tonight, their duel with unbreakable begins.

programme.title: 從今以後
programme.desc: Angie and Pat are a lesbian couple who have been together for over four decades. Pat bought an apartment over thirty years ago where they have lived ever since. The couple is open to their families and often invites Pat's family to their home for dinners. Angie's relationship with them has always been very close. When Pat passes away unexpectedly, Angie is suddenly left on her own to deal with matters related to Pat and her estate. It is not too long before a clash develops over their opinions about the burial arrangements. Angie begins to feel increasingly alienated from Pat's family..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -打開世外大門
programme.desc: “Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：任達華: 我的情敵女婿
programme.desc: An ageing bachelor playboy finally meets the girl of his dreams and proposes marriage, only to discover her psychologist stepmom was his first love long ago. The future in-laws initially pretend not to know each other but as the wedding date gets nearer, the rekindling of long-dormant feelings develops into a cross-generational love triangle.

programme.title: 無間對決
programme.desc: Major Crimes captain Park Kang-yoon (Cho Jin-woong) receives special funding to carry out his investigations and lives the life of luxury with fancy sedan, high-end condo, designer suits and accessories. A rookie named Min-jae (Choi Woo-shik) joins his unit, who happens to be very by the book. The pair becomes close as they begin investigating a new type of street drug, but Kang-yoon finds out that there is a mole within his unit, who has been compiling a case against him. As Min-jae is shown into the shady world of slush funds being used on cops, he is exposed to a secret organization within the ranks..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs..

programme.title: 華麗上班族
programme.desc: Billion-dollar Company Jones & Sunn is going public. Chairman Ho Chung-ping (Chow Yun Fat) has promised CEO Chang (Sylvia Chang), who has been his mistress for more than twenty years, to become a major shareholder of the company. As the IPO team enters the company to audit its accounts, a series of inside stories start to be revealed. Lee Xiang (Wang Ziyi), a new hire at Jones & Sunn, brings with him youthful ideals and dreams. Within the neoliberal market, the logic of intrigue rules, complicated by entanglements of love-hate relationships, which weaves a power play and a pathos-laden tragedy inside the office.

programme.title: 戀之風景
programme.desc: Mann haunted by the death of her lover, struggles to accept a new life. She goes to Qingdao in search of the landscape that her love spoke of in his final days. There, she meets a young postman Lit who runs along with Mann every day in the landscape search. While Lit gradually falls for Mann's beauty and passion, she can only think of her lost-lover and the painting..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 犯罪都市
programme.desc: Kickstarting a plan to mop up the mob in one clean sweep! 2004, Seoul. Coming from Harbin, China, JANG Chen is a new breed of gangster who single handedly takes over a mob and becomes the most feared gangster in the city. He and his merciless gang are willing to do anything it takes for money. Ruthless detective MA Seok-do wields his powerful fists to maintain peace in his city. When MA notices JANG falls his district into chaos, MA and his ragtag group of detectives form a plan to get rid of JANG and his men for good.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 犯罪都市：極拳執法
programme.desc: 4 years after the events of Garibong district round up operation, Geumcheon Police's Major Crimes Unit is given a mission to repatriate a fugitive who fled to Vietnam. Beast cop Ma Seok-do and Capt. Jeon Il-man intuitively realize that there's something wrong with the suspect's willingness to turn himself in and uncover crimes committed by a terrifying killer named Kang Hae-sang. Ma and his unit begin their investigation across two countries and follow the bloody breadcrumbs left behind by Kang..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 犯罪都市:鐵拳掃毒
programme.desc: Seven years after the roundup in Vietnam, Ma Seok-do joins a new squad to investigate a murder case. Soon, he finds out this case involves busting a synthetic drug and starts to dig deeper...Meanwhile, the guy behind it all-Joo Sung-chul -doesn't stop looking for trouble, and the Japanese drug distributors, Ricky and his gang, come to Korea to join the chaos. Things are just about to get out of hand..

programme.title: 犯罪都市: 鐵拳清算
programme.desc: While investigating a drug-trafficking app, “Monster Cop” Ma Seok-do and his team discover a connection between the app's developer, who was murdered in the Philippines, and an illegal online gambling organization. Meanwhile, in the Philippines, Baek Chang-gi is controlling the Korean online illegal gambling market and spreading terror with kidnap, assault and murder. His partner, the IT genius Chang Dong-cheol, is planning an even larger scheme in Korea itself. To put an end to the escalating threat, Detective Ma expands his operation by proposing an unexpected alliance... The fourth instalment in the Roundup series.

programme.title: 証人
programme.desc: A traffic accident changed their lives forever. In capturing wanted criminal Zhang Yidong, Sergeant Tang Fei was involved in a gunfight and car accident that put the criminal in a coma. But in the process he also crippled an fellow officer, and mistakenly shot dead the elder daughter of public prosecutor and single mother Gao Min. Unable to handle the guilt, Tang Fei succumbs to a fog of pain. Gao Min, meanwhile, pours all her love and attention to her younger daughter Ling. Three months later, the criminal Zhang Yidong awakens from his coma. Gao Min, who had been working hard on bringing him to justice, insists he stand trial immediately.

programme.title: 天下無賊
programme.desc: Bo and Li are perfect crime couple crime, until Li decides to quit. It is at the crossroad in their lives and relationships. When they run into Fu Gen, their fate is altered..

programme.title: 精武家庭
programme.desc: A mysterious person arrived in his wheelchair in Yue's Clinic and asked for a person called Tai Chi Lung. Later on, Yue was found disappeared, leaving behind his clinic a mess..

programme.title: 驅魔黑修女
programme.desc: Are you ready to venture into the forbidden? Sister Giunia is convinced that the evil spirit possessing Hee-joon is one of the 12 Manifestations. With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新劇場版：我的搬家物語 仙人掌大襲擊
programme.desc: Hiroshi was ordered to collect the fruit of cactus and was transferred to Mexico. So, Nohara family had to move to Mexico and live there. They had to bid farewell to their acquaintances and the citizens of Kasukabe with tears. Shinnosuke heard that Mexican young girls are stylish and beautiful and became eager for this journey. On arriving at Madakueruyobaka city in Mexico, a new life full of anxiety, surrounded by unique neighbors awaits them. But Shinnosuke and Nohara family had no idea that flesh-eating killer cacti are going to attack.

programme.title: 無雙
programme.desc: Lee Man, a member of a notorious money counterfeiting ring, is arrested in Thailand and extradited back to Hong Kong. Thanks to renowned painter Yuen Man, Lee is offered a deal by the police: Reveal the identity of Painter, the charismatic leader of the counterfeiting ring, and Yuen can bail him out. Lee has no choice but to comply and recount his story. In the 1990s, Lee and Yuen were lovers living together in Vancouver, seeking to be seen in the art world. However, success eludes them, and Lee is forced to go make counterfeit paintings to make a living. Lee's counterfeit paintings catch the eyes of Painter, and he decides to recruits Lee to join his team. Together with Painter's elite team, Lee travels the world in search of technologies to create the “Super Dollar,” a counterfeit bill that circumvents the anti-counterfeiting measures of the 1996 American dollar. But when Lee witnesses Painter's violent methods in action, he becomes desperate to escape his employer's grip.

programme.title: 超能神探
programme.desc: One day, Hyun-joon, a policeman who lives with his mother and his daughter, attains a superpower after getting struck by the lightning. After the incident, Hyun-joon realizes that there are others who have been going through the same situation with him, and gets involved with unexpected situations. Will he be able to succeed both, as a father who struggles with the relationship with his daughter, and as a cop with a superpower who is eager to catch an evil criminal.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 桃姐
programme.desc: Ms. Zhong Chun-tao had served the Leung's family as a domestic helper since the age of 13. Time went fast and the past sixty years flew by. During this time, some members of the Leung's family had passed away, whilst the rest had emigrated and left the country for good. For the past decade, sister Tao and the only successor of the family, Roger, were the sole remaining members. The master-servant relationship between the two was well and supportive through mutual understanding, but lack of proper communication. One day thereafter, sister Tao was found suffering from..

programme.title: 快樂到死
programme.desc: Bora Choi, who works at an English language institute, is having an affair with her ex-lover, Il-Beom Kim. Her husband, Min-ki Seo, is a former banker. He has lost his job, and has taken over the domestic roles of the house: cooking, cleaning, and watching the baby. In his free time, he watches soap operas and reads romance novels. Min-ki is aware of the affair, but seems willing to put up with it and to continue living with his cheating wife. Bora is disturbed when Il-Beom seems to want to take their affair further and pushes past her boundaries, risking to expose their relationship.

programme.title: 唱K吧！黑道之哥
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: 幽靈人間II鬼味人間
programme.desc: Jack is laden with ominous anxiety the moment he and his bride Ching step into the new apartment they recently purchase at a suspiciously low price. For one thing, his new neighbors are not only unfriendly but downright creepy. Notwithstanding Jack's miraculous recovery from a near fatal accident by a hit-and-run driver outside his building, everything starts going downhill from this point forward. On the one hand, the image of a gruesome female cadaver pops in and out of Jack's vision whenever he sneezes. On the other, Ching starts behaving most bizarrely, as if she is being possessed..

programme.title: 妖怪圖鑑
programme.desc: Sixth-grade elementary school students Kazuki, Taichi, and Sunny have a “wish” they really hope would come true. The boys pray earnestly at the shrine. Suddenly, the wish-granting “Ghost Book” resonates with them and gives them a test. Guided by the magic of the Ghost Book, the boys and their homeroom teacher, Ms. Yohko, wander into a different world where ghosts live. They try to escape through trial and error but it seems that by catching the ghosts and completing the book, their wishes will come true and they will then be able to escape from this world. Thus, the five work together to challenge the scary ghosts and hope to make their wish come true.

programme.title: 迷局伏香
programme.desc: Former Macao police captain Liang Jinghui (Lam Ka Tung) has left the force due to concerns over his mental health. He works as security at a hotel, but spends his spare time trying to put together evidence to solve a three year-old case that left one of his colleagues dead and a criminal mastermind free. When he stumbles across a cyber finance company trying to create a new financial platform in Macao, he smells a rat. He resigns from his security job and gets hired by the financial company. The keen-nosed Liang sniffs out a conspiracy that could also lead him to close the case that haunts him.

programme.title: 複製人徐福
programme.desc: Former intelligence agent Ki-hun, who lives a secluded life as a result of a traumatic memory, is entrusted by his former boss with a secret mission to transfer humanity's first cloned human, called Seobok, to a safe location. However, the mission goes awry when the convoy is ambushed by unknown attackers. Ki-hun and Seobok manage to escape together, but struggle awaits them around every corner as Seobok has spent his entire life in a lab and is fascinated by the outside world while Ki-hun only wants to complete his mission as soon as possible. As the two repeatedly butt heads, various groups with conflicting agendas chase after Seobok, who is humanity's greatest salvation but also its greatest threat. When the enemy finally closes in, Ki-hun and Seobok are forced to make the inevitable choice.

programme.title: 斷網
programme.desc: A menacing forest of fiber and data lies behind every digital screen. The Internet, while having given birth to many innovations, is also the nest of deadly computer viruses.Around the world, on a daily basis malicious hackers attack firewalls holding Governments, private companies and citizens hostage. However, not even the strongest of the hackers can do in Chun, a genius cyber security engineer who can fend off any attack with his innovative, self-developed protective firewall system. In an attempt to bring him down, unfortunately Chun gets caught up in a money laundering operation where he discovers that his boss Chi is behind the attack. To fight Chi and regain his integrity and credibility, Chun has to venture into the dark web where he can deploy an all-powerful AI virus that he created; along the way taking down violent hit-men and hackers in order to uncover the evidence of Chi's crimes. In the meantime, Chi attempts to seize Chun's technology, further resorting to.

programme.title: 人生轉運站
programme.desc: The great adventure stories of worn goods that build bridges between people from all walks of life, following a former baseball player, a sleepless student, a new hangman, an imprisoned gangster, and a mysterious father and daughter. Kwang-sung was once a rising baseball star but he is now a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted by two hitmen. One day he receives a call from a little boy Jae-ha who asks him to sell his baseball jacket. Na-na is Jae-ha's English teacher who is trying to investigate a murder case that Kwang-sung must be involved. Ye-ji helps Kwang-sung's escape when she sells Min-hyuk a sleep-time controller. Her brother Soo-jung is a hangman who actually wants to be a rock star. Jae-ha's uncle Seok-ho visits a story hunter and his mysterious daughter to sell off his old bittersweet memories. When they are about to shake hands, Anna Karenina suddenly comes in. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exciting c.

programme.title: 我左眼見到鬼
programme.desc: May marries Daniel during holiday and inherits all money after his dead. One night she suffers a fatal car accident. Ken comes to save her life and strange things happen..

programme.title: 炸豬排DJ揚太郎
programme.desc: Agetaro is the heir to his family's long-running tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) restaurant in Shibuya, Tokyo. He spends his days chopping cabbages and slacking off because he has nothing else better to do. One day, he goes to a dance club to deliver a bento, and is thrilled to get a chance to speak to Sonoko, the girl he secretly has a crush on. He also experiences the excitement of the dance floor grooving to the music for the first time, and is filled with an uplifting sensation that he has never felt before. To win Sonoko's heart, Agetaro decides to become the “Tonkatsu DJ”, a guy who can cook both tonkatsu and the dance floor.

programme.title: 銀河寫手
programme.desc: A group of young people dreaming of becoming directors, screenwriters, actors, producers, and more. Among them were two screenwriters, Zhang Liaoyi and Sun Tan. They wrote a movie script that they believed would go down in history and were determined to bring it to the big screen.

programme.title: 殺人犯
programme.desc: LING Kwong is a self-assured Chief Inspector of Police. His perfect life takes an abrupt turn when he wakes up after fainting in a dilapidated building, on one of his operations.

programme.title: 投名狀
programme.desc: In the fall of 1870, General Pang stands high atop the city walls fully attired in governor's robes. Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime and establish a new China. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. The two bandits are his sworn blood brothers: Zhao Er-Hu and Jiang Wu-Yang..

programme.title: 魔警
programme.desc: By a strange twist of fate, dutiful Hong Kong policeman Dave Wong saves the life of the leader of a violent gang of armed robbers. When they commit another crime, Dave is determined to put an end to their activities. He works with the leader, whom the gang had betrayed, to engineer a plan to wreak havoc within the gang and let the gangsters kill one another. But it becomes increasingly obvious to Dave and to his colleagues that Dave is suffering from a severe mental disorder, and Dave finds that instead of upholding the law as a righteous police officer, he has now become a fugitive wanted for murder.

programme.title: 色戒
programme.desc: Set in the deceptive Japanese occupied Shanghai in 1942. Wang is recruited to seduce the head of the regime's secret police, enrapture herself in the affair, and end his life.

programme.title: 紮職
programme.desc: William, Derek and Edward have worked for Patrick's gang in Yaumatei since they were 16. William is educated as well as courageous. After graduating from university, a former classmate referred him to a job as a debt collector for a wealthy businessman. He very quickly makes a lot of money and forms his own team. He and the businessman's daughter Michelle are very much in love. In his dealings, he offends Angry Ming. Later, in the name of gang business, and very much against Patrick's directives, William kills Angry Ming. He did this for two reasons: one, for revenge, and two, to lay the foundation for himself to become the head of the gang. But very unexpectedly, Angry Ming's widow Irene not only fights him for the position of Dragon Head, she also wants to avenge her husband, an eye for an eye. At the same time, Michelle wants William to run away to America with her, and leave gang business behind. In the end, will William be able to leave the gang completely.

programme.title: 肌智整容大叔
programme.desc: The most glamorous part of Seoul, Apgujeong thrives with new possibilities. Dae-guk who is a native of Apgujeong and rules its ground, is eager to start his own groundbreaking plastic surgery business. Then he encounters Ji-woo, the most talented surgeon in the area who lost his medical license due to someone sabotaging his reputation. Dae-guk effortlessly comes up with an idea to make this business happen, and he does everything he can to make Ji-woo his partner. Together, Dae-guk and Ji-woo open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: 月滿軒尼詩
programme.desc: Well over thirty, Lol is still like a carefree kid. His mom sets him up on a blind date with Oi-lin. The truth is, Loi and Ol-lin both have someone else in their hearts..

programme.title: Laughing Gor之潛罪犯
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops..

programme.title: 只因我們天生一對：電影版
programme.desc: Tine Mr. Chic, a cheeky good-looking university student, finds himself in big trouble after being romantically and aggressively chased by Green, a handsome guy. To push Green away, Tine asks Sarawat, the hottest guy on campus, to pretend to flirt with him. Little does he know that there is not even a shred of pretense in Sarawat's flirt. Not to Tine's knowledge, a few years ago, Sarawat met Tine at a Scrubb concert and fell for Tine ever since. That is how a fake flirt operation becomes true love for Sarawat and Tine whose story is told through hit songs by Scrubb.

credits.director: 維拉奇通吉拉, 努鄱法奈克柴威莫爾, 卡尼薩坤宇
credits.actor: Bright 瓦奇拉維特奇瓦雷
Win 梅塔文歐帕西安卡瓊

programme.title: EXIT：極限逃生
programme.desc: Yong-nam was one of the best rock climbers in college but hasn't had much luck elsewhere after graduation. He has failed to get a job for many years and has to rely on his parents just to get by. For his mother's 70th birthday, he insisted on having the party at Dream Garden because his old crush, Eui-ju works there. When a disaster strikes, covering an entire district in Seoul with mysterious white gas, he has to use all of his rock climbing skills with the help of Eui-ju to get everyone to safety..

programme.title: 七劍
programme.desc: In the early 1660's the Manchurians took over the sovereignty of China and established the Qing Dynasty. With many pro-nationalist revolts occurring, the newly set-up government immediately imposed a ban on the study and practice of the Martial Arts. Fire-wind, a military official from the previous dynasty, ravages and ranges across North-western China with his next goal to attack the final frontier - the intransigent and hold-out town know as the Martial Village. Fu Qinghu, a retired executioner from the previous dynasty, feels a moral obligation to try and put a stop to this brutality and decides to save Martial Village. He convinces two young people from the village to travel with him to Mount Heaven in order to seek help from Master Shadow-Glow, a hermit who is a master of swords and leads a group of disciples with unimaginable swordsmanship..

programme.title: 勿說是推理
programme.desc: One day, a talkative college student with a natural perm, Totonou Kunou visits Hiroshima for an art exhibition, and there meets a teenage girl, Shioji Kariatsumari, who says she is a friend of Garo Inudo. “Would you work for me? Lives and money are at stake. I'm serious.” She offers Totonou a part-time job, which turns out to be related to the succession of an enormous inheritance. Totonou decides to help her out, only to get involved in an inheritance battle of the noble and shady Kariatsumari family, where people have been killed for generations. Multiple dark sides and mysteries of the family are laid out behind the inheritance. What truth is buried there.

programme.title: 朝花夕拾．芳華絕代
programme.desc: 2013, after the auction of items from Anita's estate, seemingly insignificant items are transported to a garbage dump. A number of fans try to salvage what they can in the dead of night. Undeterred by the conditions or the imminent threat of arrest, they work meticulously to save each of these treasures. Handwritten cards, letters and small hand-crafted gifts from fans, some even forgotten by the people who originally made them, every single one of these seemingly insignificant items kept and lovingly treasured by Anita over the years. Not wanting Anita's treasures to be condemned to landfills, these fans save and endeavour to return each of these to their original owner. Through their journey back to their original owner, we trace the stories of several fans whose lives were touched and forever changed by their chance encounters with their idol. Stories of: Growing confidence, Inspiration, Courage, Rekindled faith in people, and Friendship. Life may end but love and memorie.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 暴瘋語
programme.desc: Three years ago, FAN (LAU Ching Wan) had a schizophrenic breakdown and killed his wife (Michelle YE Xuan). He later attempted to commit suicide but was unsuccessful, and was eventually sentenced to rehabilitate in a psychiatric facility indefinitely. Dr. CHOW (HUANG Xiao Ming) is FAN's psychiatrist. He believes FAN is cured after 3-year treatment and is alone in opposition to all doctors' objections to discharge FAN. After releasing from the facility, FAN faces discrimination and misunderstanding and once again finds himself at the brink of collapse. One night, he mistakenly kills a drug addict on impulse. He is driven to despair and comes to Dr. CHOW for help.Having thought about it, Dr CHOW fears his career will be wrecked if it is uncovered and therefore helps FAN abscond. The concealment of the truth subtly snowballs into chaos as it triggers media criticism and attacks due to his missing murderous patient. In order to redeem himself, CHOW decides to cure FAN with a confi.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -跨越四徑挑戰
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.

programme.title: 淪落人
programme.desc: A paralyzed and hopeless man meets his new Filipino domestic helper who has put her dreams on hold to come to Hong Kong to earn a living. These two strangers live under the same roof, and they learn to face the different seasons of life.

programme.title: 原罪犯
programme.desc: One night in 1988, ordinary-man OH Dae-su, who lives with his wife and an adorable baby daughter, is kidnapped. He later wakes up to find himself in a private makeshift prison. While suffering from his debacle, Dae-su becomes shocked when he watches the news and hears that his beloved wife was brutally murdered. 15 years later, Dae-su is released and he determines to find out the truth. He meets Mi-do, the cook of the restaurant Dae-su has his first-meal after his imprisonment, and tells her about his 15 years in confinement. Mi-do promises to help him seek vengeance. As the team approaches the truth, another shocking-secret is revealing...

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: 人間蒸發
programme.desc: Jia Jia went to Japan with her fiance to meet her family. As soon as she arrived at the foot of Mount Fuji, she was imprisoned by local villagers and led an inhuman life. The cowardly Hirota only knew how to sorrow through wine. Jia Jia's good sister Wei Ling resolutely went to Japan to find Jia Jia. With the help of agent Kinoshita, the investigation gradually deepened, but the surrounding environment became more and more sinister. Hirota was strangled to death in a hot spring pool. Michiko went mad because of extreme fear. Yuko was still sane but unable to express when she was attacked. Tadao often spied Wei Ling through the cracks in the door. Residents under the shadow of nuclear radiation gradually lost their humanity, like a hyena, and ready to bite Wei Ling this outsider.

programme.title: 大上海
programme.desc: It was 1917, China. CHENG was an innocent young man who worked in a grocery store and had no ambition, other than to be with his lovely neighbour, the Peking Opera student QIU. But a fateful night had changed Cheng's life forever, as he literally walked right in the affair between his lady boss and the chief of police. To hide this secret, the chief decided to throw Cheng into prison, accusing him of raping his lady boss. Desolated, Cheng met a cellmate MAO, who happened to have an escape plan. The duo broke out, and Cheng had no choice but to leave his life, and his dream girl behind..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom.

programme.title: 龍虎門
programme.desc: Tiger gets the Lousha Death Plaque accidentally, which represents the power to control Lousha Gate. During his celebration the gang ambushes Tiger, who knows zero of the Plaque..

programme.title: 激戰
programme.desc: After a stint in prison for participating in underground boxing, Fai is knee-deep in debt with no solution in sight. To escape his debtors, he flees to Macau and works as a gym assistant. He meets and ends up training Si-Qi, a hot-blooded young man who enrolled in an open MMA competition with no fighting experience. After a series of wins, Si-Qi is critically injured and eliminated from the tournament. Ignited by Si-Qi's persistence and unwillingness to give up in the face of defeat, he rediscovers his will to fight and steps back in the ring against the fighter who injured his student..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 頭文字Ｄ
programme.desc: Takumi delivers tofu in father's old Toyota every day and unwittingly acquires difting skills. An unexpected victory awakens his competitive genes, leading him to fierce races.

programme.title: 總理之夫
programme.desc: Ornithologist (a scholar of birds) Hiyori Soma is married to Rinko, leader of a minority political party. One morning, his beloved wife poses an enigmatic question. “Hey, Hiyori, would you have a problem if I became Prime Minister?” He asks her to repeat the question, but she shrugs him off. Still confused, he sets off for a ten-day expedition on a remote island with no cell phone connection to observe birds in the wild. In his absence, Rinko changes the future of the nation! She is elected the first female Prime Minister in Japan's history, making Hiyori the first ever Prime Minister's husband. He was always 100% supportive of Rinko's political ambitions, but could never have imagined the life that awaited him..

programme.title: The Moon: 緊急營救
programme.desc: In 2029, South Korea's lunar exploration spacecraft Woori-ho embarks on a journey towards the Moon. The whole world pays attention to this great challenge, but a solar flare erupts, causing a solar wind to engulf the spacecraft, leaving only the crew member Hwang Sun-woo stranded alone. This is not the first time that South Korea's spacecraft has headed to the Moon. Five years ago, the Narae-ho soared into the sky with grand dreams, only to blow up into pieces upon launch. Now, in the face of another tragedy, the only survivor, Sun-woo, becomes the focus of the efforts of the Korea Aerospace Research Institute and the government. The entire nation hopes for his safe return. To ensure Sun-woo's rescue, the former flight director, Kim Jae-gook, who had been researching deep in the mountains, takes responsibility for the Narae-ho accident five years ago and rejoins the mission. However, his efforts alone are not enough. In search of another hope to rescue Sun-woo, Kim seeks the.

programme.title: 過時．過節
programme.desc: The chaos began at the Winter Solstice dinner eight years ago. The father lost his temper, the son, not able to forgive his father, ran away from home. Eight years have passed, and the family's relationship is still cold and distant. A cousin returns to Hong Kong from England and hopes to gather everyone for a Winter Solstice dinner. The long-awaited gathering prompted everyone to rethink their relationships with family members. Some choose to leave, some are back. When things are about to fall apart, it might as well be an opportunity to mend connections.

programme.title: 不義之戰
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive..

programme.title: 片場職人 -譚耀文
programme.desc: Patrick Tam started as a singer, who had been embracing a dream in films, later successfully turned into actor after the film “Beast Cops”. Having played antagonists throughout the years, how does he feel towards the ‘Villain Label'? In this episode, Patrick shares his experience in portraying different roles, the change in mindset after becoming an actor as well about his life insights.

programme.title: 西遊記之大鬧天宮
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time, there existed in the world three clans; human, god and demon. As everything was destroyed during the great battle, Nuwa (Goddess of Works) used 36,500 magic boulders to repair Heaven. One of them fell accidentally down onto Earth and landed on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits on an island far across the Eastern Sea. Over thousands of years, the magic boulder absorbed the energies of Heaven and Earth and the sacred lights of the Sun and Moon. A godly creature was nurtured inside the stone-egg and a full-grown monkey burst out from it one day. When the Patriarch Subodhi passed by on his way to collect herbs in the Mountain, he came upon the monkey. Impressed by his exceptional wit and godly he took the monkey back to the Divine Cave of Three Stars in Mountain Mi to teach him the Way and called him Sun Wukong..

programme.title: 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 500 years after the havoc in heaven, Xuanzang, the Tang Priest, is appointed by the Buddha to go to the West to fetch the Buddhist scriptures. By accident, Xuangzang undoes the Buddha's spell on Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. Wukong brought under control by a gold hoop given by the Mercy Goddess. He has no choice but to accept the mission to escort Xuanzang to the West. Despite his reluctance. Wukong cuts paths all the way and dutifully helps to subdue Bajie and Sha. But the hoop on this head, effective with his master's restrictive incantation, always remains a vexation for Wukong. Lady White Bone Spirit from the White Tiger Ridge aims to kill and eat Xuanzang's golden body for evading her doom of reincarnation from a demon to any other creature. After dealing with the four, White Bone Spirit has an insight into the barrier between Wukong and Xuanzang. So, she designs traps to foment discord between them. Humiliated mistakenly, Wukong still fights on with both strength and wit.

programme.title: 西遊記之女兒國
programme.desc: On the conflict-packed journey to the West for the scriptures, escorted by Sun, Bajie and Sha, Xuanzang, the Tang Priest, accidentally enters the Womanland of Western Liang, a mysterious nation where no men has ever been existed. The Queen falls for Xuanzang at first sight, without knowing what love is, thinking she could be terminally ill with incurable lovesickness. The Preceptor warns her that men are all poisonous creatures and orders to kill Xuanzang and his disciples. With the help of the Queen, the four flee the execution site, but later Xuanzang, Bajie and Sha carelessly drink the water from the Motherhood River that makes them pregnant rapidly. Wukong tries to save the three with his almighty transforming sorcery, when Xuanzang gradually loses his stand to falls in love with the Queen. The trespass of the four outsiders also agitates the God of River Oblivion, who completely breaks the peace of the Womanland. The River God floods the whole nation in a fury and puts i.

programme.title: 脫單香氣神助攻
programme.desc: Chang-soo, a guy who has never been in a romantic relationship, earns a magical power after accidentally wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger. The supernatural power he earns is what any man would dream of, an ability to attract every woman in the world! Ara, a woman Chang-soo has been in love with, begins to sense the scent of Chang-soo and falls in love with him. While they gradually grow their connection, Ara's ex-boyfriend, James, suddenly appears and reveals Chang-soo's secret! Will the two people overcome this predicament and find true love in each other.

programme.title: 毒舌大狀
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit.

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 封神第一部
programme.desc: Long ago, the mystic sages in Kunlun saw that humankind had descended into chaos. A King consumed by his lust for power and aided by evil beings threatened the mortal world. One Immortal was willing to sacrifice his immortality to try and save mankind. Beguiled by a beautiful Fox Demon, there is nothing that can stop the ambitious King Zhou and his band of loyal disciples. The King unleashes a brutal campaign upon the land, and forces the lords of all the other realms to deliver their sons to him as wards. Loyalty to the King is tested against loyalty to family as sons are forced to murder their fathers. Black magic aids the King, but the heavens are on the side of the hero! Can the heavens possibly save mankind? Which will prevail, power or peace..

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t.

programme.title: 大事件
programme.desc: A TV news unit live broadcasts the embarrassing defeat of a police battalion by five bank robbers. Later, Inspector Rebecca decides to turn the stakeout into a breaking news show.

programme.title: 緊急迫降
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.

programme.title: 大追捕
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong celebrity is found brutally murdered, detective Lam is called in to take charge. But the more that Lam pursues his suspect, the deeper he falls into a web of lies.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -打開世外大門
