programme.desc: “Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.

programme.title: LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.

programme.title: 寒戰
programme.desc: Approaching midnight in Hong Kong, police headquarters receives an anonymous call: a police van carrying the advanced equipment and five officers has disappeared off the grid..(n)

programme.title: 武替道
programme.desc: LEE Sam was the undisputed king of stunt choreography during the golden era of Hong Kong action cinema in the 80s. After a devastating stunt accident, Sam steps away from the industry for 30 years. However, his old friend, a veteran director, has now persuaded Sam to work as the stunt choreographer on what will be the director's last film. The only catch is that his film stars Wai - Sam's former stunt crew member who has since become a famous action star in his own right. Sam and Wai have a contentious history, with Sam's infamously overbearing and demanding personality clashing with Wai's own ego and ambition. By chance, Sam crosses paths with a young, ambitious stuntman named LEE Sai Long, who sees this as an opportunity to advance his career. Long is caught between Sam and his former protege turned rival. At the same time, Long helps Sam to reconcile with his estranged daughter, Cherry. As Sam returns to the world he once dominated, he must confront his past, mend fences w.(n)

programme.title: 忠烈楊家將
programme.desc: The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father..(n)

programme.title: 百年好合
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung (Louis Koo) is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May (Sammi Cheng). The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery (Li Bing-Bing) shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost'Heartbreak Sword Technique'..(n)

programme.title: 臥底女神團
programme.desc: Shih Tzu is a tough journalist; despite, being a tiny lady with 155cm height. All her life, she's been teased about being so tiny. So, she determines to have a tall boyfriend and when she gets married, she can have tall children. She even wishes to name her baby “Giraffe.” As soon as she meets Faifa, the tallest senior in her university, who becomes a dedicated and hardworking Police Officer, she determines to win his heart. Would she be able to excel in her career and make him fall in love with her.(n)

programme.title: 危樓深淵
programme.desc: An ordinary office worker Dong-won (KIM Sung-kyun) and his family move into a house he bought after years of saving. Overwhelmed with happiness, he invites his colleagues to a housewarming party, but heavy overnight rain leads to a gigantic sinkhole, and in a mere minute, it swallows up the entire apartment and the people inside. Hundreds of meters down the hole, Dong-won, his neighbor Man-su (CHA Seoung-won), and the unfortunate housewarming party guests must find their way out. Rain starts to pour down, filling the sinkhole with water, giving them very little time to get back to the surface.(n)

programme.title: 飯戲攻心
programme.desc: It is often said that food and meals bring families together, but in TABLE FOR SIX it's clear that not all family gatherings are a cause for celebration. In this melodramatic comedy, three brothers reside in a home that they inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother Steve (Dayo Wong), theoretically is the man of the house, but he constantly is getting dissed by his two younger brothers Bernard (Louis Cheung Kai Chung) and Lung (Chan Charm Man Peter) for the decisions he makes, the inedible meals that he cooks, and his complicated romantic encounters. To prepare for a family reunion dinner, Steve seeks the help of Lung's girlfriend and foodie Josephine (Ivana Wong) and in doing so, wins back their hearts for a while, until his old flame and Bernard's new girlfriend Monica (Stephy Tang) shows up. That's a recipe for a disaster waiting to explode! The unexpected visit of Steve's part-time girlfriend Meow (Lin Min-Chen) not only fails to turn down the heat and cool th.(n)

programme.title: 聽見兩個世界
programme.desc: Dai is born to deaf parents and has been raised with deep love in rural Japan. However, as he grows older, he becomes troubled by his differences from others and begins to blame his deaf mother for his daily frustrations. When he turns 20, Dai leaves home for Tokyo as if to escape. Life in Tokyo was lonely at first, but when Dai starts working as a magazine reporter, he finds fulfillment in meeting a diverse group of people. Time eventually passes, and Dai returns home for the first time in eight years. In spending peaceful time with his deaf mother after a long time, a memory that has been sealed away unexpectedly comes back to Dai.(n)

programme.title: 烏托邦浩劫
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.(n)

programme.title: 長安三萬里
programme.desc: A few years after the outbreak of the Anshi Rebellion, the Tubo army attacked the southwest. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the isolated city, recalled his life with Li Bai to the eunuch of the supervising army.(n)

programme.title: 殺人預言
programme.desc: One day, the dead body of Min-tae only brother Seok-tae was found, and Seok-tae ‘s wife Moon-young has disappeared. While searching for clues on this brother's death, Min-tae found that a novelist Ho-ryung also following the same trail and he discovered that the death of his brother was predicted in Ho-ryung's bestselling novel, ‘Nocturnal.' Min-tae was thrown into confusion and brother's gang and police also getting involved in the case. To find out the truth behind brother's death, Min-tae began a relentless and furious pursuit..(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....(n)

programme.title: 竊聽風雲3
programme.desc: Five Years ago, LAW was jailed for killing a major land owner in a car accident. At that time LAW worked as a chauffeur for the rural tycoon LUK. It was rumored that LUK was behind such land owner's death, which gave LUK a competitive edge in the native apartment development deal. Before the Hong Kong handover in 1997, every native, male resident in the New Territories was granted the right to build a house. Yet it had caused social unrest over the land right, until recently the government decided to gather all of the remaining land rights from these residents and plan to build taller apartment buildings. LUK wished to swallow the enormous project and this started the fights between LUK, the land owner and other real estate developers. When LAW gets out of prison five years later, the world has changed..(n)

programme.title: 攝氏32度
programme.desc: A nameless hitwoman who, for reasons not entirely clear, has a lower than average body temperature. She is cold-blooded in other ways as well, assassinating her targets with steely detachment and having only two real acquaintances: the Cambodian woman who gives her killing assignments and money, and the street vendor Long Shek, at whose stand she habitually relaxes after successful hits with a bowl of noodles. Long Shek dubs her Pretty Ghost, and the two gradually become something like friends. Pretty Ghost ends up traveling to South Korea to assassinate a local gangland kingpin, a job she decides will be her last. However, the dead man's bodyguard, Yichin, is out for revenge and comes after Pretty Ghost..

programme.title: 夏日福星
programme.desc: Muscles, Kidstuff, Fung, and the gang taking a well-needed vacation in Thailand courtesy of the Hong Kong police department. Also on the trip is police inspector Woo on orders to track down a list of drug dealers from informant Ma. Unfortunately, Ma gets whacked by a Thai crime lord, but he tells Woo as he draws his last breath that he mailed the list to his friend in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, Muscles and the gang are shaking down Lau, a drug dealer who, it turns out, is being targeted by the same baddies that killed Ma..

programme.title: 鼠膽龍威
programme.desc: Jet Li was a police when he lived in China, owing to his wife and son's death in a case of extort, it made him give up his career as a police and resigned. For a time he disappeared and no one could find him. Jet was eager to find the killer of his wife and son but he was familiar with the killer's voice only. After two year, while Loong Wei a famous action star presented himself on a high risk jump, he actually was as timid as a mouse..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: Chit the Kick breaks his leg in the fight with Wong Fey Hong, and is discarded by godfather Chao. Wong nurses him and teams up with him in a martial arts tournament to defeat Chao..

programme.title: 黑馬王子
programme.desc: Wah is an unkempt, uneducated and undiplomatic guy who is doomed to be a loser of love. Bok Ping is a stylish Shanghai girl with a tycoon father. But Bok Ping decides to go to Hong Kong to seek her mother, who has departed from her when she was a child. She encounters Wah in the process and lives a simple life with Wah's mother. Wah, being influenced by Bok Ping, becomes more polite and cultured. Meanwhile, Bok Ping's father deems that Wah has kidnapped his daughter, but unexpectedly, Bok Ping has really been kidnapped..

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: 搗「誕」學園: 逃學威龍2
programme.desc: The story is about sing, who becomes a traffic cop, determines to be an undercover again at school to regain his reputation of being a leader of SDU.

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: Receiving a humiliating demotion to traffic duty, Chan decides to take a vacation with girlfriend May. However, when terrorists threaten Hong Kong, he abort his vacation plans..

programme.title: 合家歡
programme.desc: Michael Hui plays the lovable 'Mr. Coconut', who arrives in town from China where he lived with his coconuts. Here in the sophisticated urban jungles of Hong Kong..

programme.title: 刺客新傳之殺人者唐斬
programme.desc: A country bumpkin and flower lover, Tong Po, falls in love with a girl, he is not allowed to marry. They try to run away together, but they are captured and he is thrown into a jail where his eyes are sewn shut. Next, his eyes are opened to find himself and some fellow prisoners in a gladiatorial ring where they must kill each other in order to survive, the last man standing gets to live and be trained as an executioner for a power corrupted eunuch. Tong Po wins of course, becomes an adept killing machine, is renamed Tong Chop, and given an apprentice who both idolizes and wants to replace him. During one nighttime raid, Tong sees the girl and his past starts creeping back on him, so he leaves the killing business and hides out with her in her village where she has remarried and has a son..

programme.title: 魔翡翠
programme.desc: Archaeologist Shum finds an antique jade with supernatural power in Greece. The stone is wanted both by KGB's agent Karoff and the Interpol. Shum asks his friend Nike (Andy Lau) for help. However, Shum is finally caught by KGB but the jade is slipped into the hands of a boy called Pan. He discovers the crystal is from space and they become friends. While Nike is imputed and jailed, Karoff comes and captures Pan to get the jade.....

programme.title: 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: Chit the Kick breaks his leg in the fight with Wong Fey Hong, and is discarded by godfather Chao. Wong nurses him and teams up with him in a martial arts tournament to defeat Chao..

programme.title: 龍鳳茶樓
programme.desc: Dragon and Pool are friends in the triad. Dragon saves Gigi and touches her at a life and death moment. But they have an inexplicable history which is a thwart to their love..

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 新最佳拍檔
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: 七年之癢
programme.desc: Living together for 7 years, Raymond has been faithful to Sylvia. But he is eager to having an affair after being teased by his colleagues. On his business trip to Singapore, he is being used by a charming girl, Siu Hung to smuggle some stolen jewelry. Raymond mistakes for love luck yet he fails to have an affair with Siu Hung before she sneaks away with the jewelry. When he returns home, a diamond ring is found in his luggage and Sylvia takes it as her birthday present. Raymond is so involved with Siu Hung that he decides to take Sylvia on a trip to Singapore to bring back the memory. He requests Sylvia to act if they were first met, but it comes an intruder Money who falls in love with Sylvia at first sight..

programme.title: 音樂殭屍
programme.desc: A crazy white scientist resurrects a corpse with a weird chemical creating a super hopping ghost. The only thing that can somewhat control it is the sound of music. A Tao Priest and his two assistants try and stop it from destroying the countryside..

programme.title: 倫文敘老點柳先開
programme.desc: Lun was a smart scholar who liked to do petty tricks. Lau had been practicing martial arts. Lun and Lau formed an odd couple of school and had small disputes all the time.

programme.title: 雞同鴨講
programme.desc: Michael Hui's classic satire about Chinese food versus the new - in which he plays restaurant owner struggling to survive under the commercial attacks by the modern enterprise..

programme.title: 搶錢夫妻
programme.desc: “Always On My Mind” is about self-discovery of a man after being diagnosed with an incurable disease. Michael Hui plays the coward newscaster-turned-opportunistic-moneygrubber..

programme.title: 精裝追女仔3狼之一族
programme.desc: Personal and interest conflicts between two garage owners Ken and Jim along with Ken's four young men staffs and Jim's four young girl helpers make them compete with each other..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯：搗「誕」學園: 流氓師表
programme.desc: Mildly entertaining low-budget quickie that basically rips off Great Teacher Onizuka with less drama and a much less appealing lead actor. Nick Cheung is a triad who's hired by old classmate Lo May to teach a class of reprobates.

programme.title: 警察故事III
programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.

programme.title: 妖魔道
programme.desc: Cher Kei was waiting for 500 years for the reason she hope an evil girl would growth. Her thought was combining the evil power of Choi Yi and her together. Thus she can govern the world of human being. But the master Bai Mei wanted to destroy the project of cher kei. Thus, Bai Mei took away Choi Yi , and made her to be a follower. When Choi Yi was eighteen. Bai Mei made Choi Yi get married with Liu Chun because she wanted to clear the evil property of Choi Yi..

programme.title: 知法犯法
programme.desc: Police constable Mike is suspended from duty charged with abusing the use of his gun in a robbery. During his suspension from duty, Mike meets a Triad Society Big Brother, Tin, and admires his lifestyle and also his sexy wife. Mike is apparently dismissed but in fact becoming a stoolie. Mike eventually becomes Tin's bodyguard, and discovers that his buddy Chung also becomes a stoolie. Mike uses the Police Force to get rid of all big brothers and intends to become the head of the Society, as well as taking over Tin's wife. For his own sake, Mike even kills his buddy Chung and kidnaps Tin..

programme.title: 我在黑社會的日子
programme.desc: Hung Hing Family boss Lee Qun was ambushed on his way to Macau. His heir Lee Mun-ho flew back from the States for the funeral. Mun-ho, who did not want to mingle with the mobsters, planned to return to the States for good after wrapping up his father's business in Hong Kong. However, through his intelligence and managerial skills, he turned Hung Hing into a well organized business structure. On the other hand, Yeung Kong, a young and ambitious mobster who was brought up under the old Triad tradition, strongly opposed Mun-ho..

programme.title: 野獸刑警
programme.desc: Mike is an expatriate inspector and is put in charge of an anti-Triad unit. The group includes Chao, a bad-tempered, undisciplined policeman who cause him so much trouble. And now they are facing a big problem, the reigning king of the streets, Wah, a crimeload on the rise..

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 少林英雄之方世玉洪熙官
programme.desc: The August of Ching Dynasty Emperor Keen-Lung thirty-second year, general Ko Chun Chung got the help from Master White-Eyebrow and his two apprentices Kam Fung Cheung and Cheung Man Cheung to destroy Shaolin temple, but it was quite regretful some Monks including Hung Hei Kwun has escaped. After that the Emperor Keen-Lung promoted Ko Chun Chung as Guangzhou Governor and to get rid of all the people of Hung's group. In order to reunion Ming Dynasty, Hung hided himself in a red boat. One day, he went to town and saved young Fung Sai Yuk..

programme.title: 大冒險家
programme.desc: 20 years ago, in the region of Golden Triangle, Wah(aged about 9) and his parents, his god father (Keung) with his daughter (aged about 5) planned to smuggle some valuable items and information into Thailand. Wah's father, Keung and Leung were the closest of friends, just like blood brothers, all 3 of them were C.I.A. agents. Keung left for Thailand before the others to plan the operation. Leung ganged up with some bandits and forced Wah's father to surrender the confidential information. Wah, hidden in the dark, saw his parents being killed. 20 years later, Wah became an officer in the Thai Air Force. He couldn't take his mind off the revenge. Leung became a successful business man. He was in Thailand to launch a major business project. Ignoring Keung's advise, Wah and Roy slipped into Leung's hotel to try to assassinate him..

programme.title: 猛鬼撞鬼
programme.desc: Taxi dancer Yue puts herself head over heels in debt because of gambling. She tries to borrow a loan from her close friend, Ngor, with tricks of suicide. She pretendedly pushes Ngor down a tall building but falls from the rooftop herself. She has got a narrow escape and a windfall of picking up a sack of money from a Chinese spiritualized vase which belongs to a big brother, Hung. With the help of the spirit, Yue and Ngor win so much that they almost lose their sense. They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives..

programme.title: 九龍冰室
programme.desc: Ex-convict Dragon works as a waiter after his release from prison. He has no idea that he is now a father, until his six-year-old son greets him 'Dad' upon his release..

programme.title: 流氓公僕
programme.desc: Bill and Lee are a pair of old hands working with the Action Squad in the Police Department. They both have their shortcomings. Bill likes to bet a bit to lighten up and Lee likes to flirt with pretty girls. But their little tales do not in anyway interfere with their dedication towards their work. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way..

programme.title: 水滸傳之英雄本色
programme.desc: The story between Lin Chun, the 'leopard' and Lu Chi-sum, the 'sharp-witted monk' is one of the most brilliantly portrayed episode in the Chinese novel 'All men are brothers'. The story tells of Lin Chun, Chief Instructor of eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards, is naive to the intricacy of power politics. His honesty and loyalty leads him to be framed by the treacherous court officials..

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee love little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Ms Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs.Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 金三角群英會
programme.desc: BULLET and MOON are two tough ladies who are out to bust the biggest drug syndicate in Thailand and they only have ten days to do it! Nothing is beyond these fighting women as they enter the Golden triangle unafraid because they are on a “MISSION OF JUSTICE”! Through the jungle they pursue the dangerous Yie Feng as they track her into the very heart of Cala. Working under-cover they both find their lives at risk to the deadly Drug Lords. Only their superior fighting skills can keep them from being killed..

programme.title: 搗「誕」學園: 超級學校霸王
programme.desc: In the year 2043, the notorious villain is about to be put on trial. His killers decide to go back 50 years by the time tunnel, and look for the judge in his youthful age..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened..

programme.title: 中華英雄
programme.desc: Hero goes home with excited but he finds his parent was killed. Gian took a group of foreigners to Hero's parents and forced them to hand over the Red Sword, their family treasure..

programme.title: 明月照尖東
programme.desc: Police detective Ming loses his gun during a drunken binge and attempts to recover it while romancing PR girl Tweedy. That's the gist of the first two-thirds of the slackly-paced story, which is enlivened by a gun battle, a chase on foot through speeding cars, and comic relief provided by Ming's partner. Things really heat up, though, when Tweedy's old boyfriend Prince, a psychotic killer, comes back to town..

programme.title: 大冒險家
programme.desc: 20 years ago, in the region of Golden Triangle, Wah(aged about 9) and his parents, his god father (Keung) with his daughter (aged about 5) planned to smuggle some valuable items and information into Thailand. Wah, hidden in the dark, saw his parents being killed. 20 years later, Wah became an officer in the Thai Air Force. He couldn't take his mind off the revenge. Leung became a successful business man. He was in Thailand to launch a major business project. Ignoring Keung's advise, Wah and Roy slipped into Leung's hotel to try to assassinate him..

Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way..

programme.title: 江湖告急

Kitty then decided Cheung should stay in Hong Kong as to earn more money and she and their daughter will stay and wait in Canada. Cheung who stayed alone in Hong Kong, thus begins the affair with his beautiful boss. When Kitty learns Cheung's affair, she threatens a divorce. Meanwhile, Cheung finds his boss is only frustrated him, Cheung quits and leaves for Canada where Kitty is already pregnant their second child..

One day her ex-boyfriend came back from US and..

Lui Lun (Yuen Biao) is also fully grown, and well-versed in Kung Fu, but he has no idea that his parents were murdered, as he was adopted by a wise man who owns an escort agency. Snow entangles her brother in her plot to gain revenge when.

The Police suspicious Lung had hidden the money. So he was wanted by the triad society and Police. Sing was a little thief, he knew Lung and made friend together. He knew everything about Lung then, and he wanted to help Lung to recover his memory aimed to take back the money. Fong was a manger in a big firm. He had stolen a large amount of money of his firm and was discovered by his colleague later. So he wanted to kill Wu but failed. Fong also wanted the money of Lung, as a result, he wanted to kill Lung also. Wu was saved by Lung and Sing. The Boss of Fong knew everything were exposed and ordered Koo to kill Lung, Sing and Wu. The mob's second in charge Uncle Yee wants to kill Shuet's father and to take his place. Mumble retreats from Wai Heung who constantly wants to kill him.....

programme.title: 義膽雄心
programme.desc: Fen Chiu Hung (Alex Man) is a retired San Francisco cop who goes to Hong Kong to rescue the kidnapped son of his former business associate Mr. Brown (Roger Ball). Fen loves karaoke club owner Shirley (Kelly Yiu), but she has secretly married to gangster Brother Pu (Chan Wai Man), who years ago fled to Japan to avoid retaliation for his killing of a rival Hong Kong gangster. Shirley has a daughter Cindy (Regina Kent), who is dating Alex's jovial friend Che (Andy Lau). Che is an employee of the wealthy Mr. Brown, who is married to a Chinese lady. After Fen and Che bravely rescue the kid from his Japanese captors, their gang boss Mr. Nakamura (Luk Chuen) swears revenge for his men who were killed in the raid. Pu has joined the Japanese triad societies, and now works for Nakamura, who flies him back to Hong Kong to kill Fen.

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: Lang Kim Sang, a famous Cantonese Opera actress, strives to revitalize the traditional art. She hires a new director but stirs up resentment and jealousy within the troupe..

programme.title: 天下無敵

Included are some of Jackie Chan's greatest moves and stunts, from ten of his classic Hong Kong films including Cub Tiger from Kwantung, Shaolin Wooden Men, Spiritual Kung Fu, and many more. And also includes footage of various Kung Fu styles.

On the other hand, since Zhou suspected “hungry wolf” to be a luster, she reacted strangely and made a lot of jokes during the course of the investigation..

Yet May's father strongly objected their relations and separated them trickily, with the help of Kwun. One day, May come backs - but with her six-year-old son, Sam. He begins to get back what he loses five years ago. May actually been badly ill before she comes back Hong Kong. Her only wish before die is to bring Sam back to Hung. After May has died, May's father insists to keep Sam by his sides. Hung tries his best to get back Sam. In order to earn more money, he does a very dangerous stunt. At last, he is injured..

Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

A Taoist Priest and local elder, E-mei, opposed it by referring that the church was haunted. Dominated by his son David, the town mayor townsfolk to vote for it in order to smuggle drugs and exercise black magic..

programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.

The monks stay at the Temple is prolonged due to Fong carelessly misplacing their valuable Taolisman, the Gold Suddna. Due to the suspicion of Alex's fidelity, Chu and Vivian follow Alex to Paris and cause dramatic argument with Joe. Because Chu feels her relationship with Alex is in danger, she threatens Alex to marry her once they return to Hong Kong. Otherwise, she will marry Alex's cousin and go to Canada..

Unfortunately, Lau fell in love with Ng's girlfriend and they had an affair. Then, Ng found that she too has fallen for Lau which further complicated the matter. The three were thrown into conflicts. On the other hand, they accidentally discovered Prosecutor Ng Chun Yue was taking the laws into his own hands and this led them into serious troubles.......

Bill falls in love with Vivian at first sight, and Columbus promises to arrange an audition for Vivian. Everything seems fine and Vivian is one step away from her dream. But right at this moment, Vivian losses her eyesight and is abducted by some drug dealer at the same time. Is Vivian going to make her dream come true? Or is there a shattered dream waiting for her.

programme.title: 賭俠2之上海灘賭聖
programme.desc: Coming back learning from the God of Gambler, Star accidentally falls into a time tunnel and back to Shanghai in 1937, where he meets his grandfather Fook, Yvonne and Danny..

programme.desc: Chicken, Wing and Zita worked in the same police station. Chicken used to make friends with many gangsters; Wing is a pro in computer knowledge; Zita came from a affluent family but devoted to her work. Zita was transferred to Chicken‘s team as their superintendent was termed “The Team in Vain”. Chicken was found to have committed a serious mistake in a mission and was sacked. Zita, as Chicken's girlfriend thought he would reform. However, to her disappointment, Zita discovered Chicken became a procurer in one of her missions. A series of murder was reported, the victims were all teenagers and were killed after they met with a friend from Internet. Wing was assigned to be the bait in this case..

It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor..

Mud Carp, the second sister, becomes a lawyer after university. Her boyfriend, David, comes from a rich family. In view of this, she dares not tell David her family background even though they are planning to get married. Kudzu always hopes her youngest sister Bean, to further her studies but she falls in love with a middle-aged butcher, Wing. One day, Kudzu discovers that her good friend, Keung, has a long-lost brother, and comes to the hopeful conclusion that his lost brother is Alex. In the process of helping Keung to find his brother, the relationship between the three sisters changed..

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香

Hong killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting , to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found..

programme.title: 繼續跳舞
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 精裝追女仔
programme.desc: Fred, foul-mouthed, together with his two close buddies, Silver and Tony, are working in a garage. Their boss, Ken, is harsh and dingy. However, a warm and close friendship has been established among the four. In order to recover the heartbreak of Fred, Ken suggested a tour to Penang to cheer up Fred. They came across two beautiful girls, Maggie and Agnes, strolling leisurely on the beach as if they were very wealthy. Since then they decided on courtship. They played a poker game to decide who's to who. And Fred, the winner, chose Maggie to be his sole target. By the rules of the game, Ken, Silver and Tong have to compete to see who in the ends will win the heart of Agnes..

At the cemetery, Mak Ka Kei caught sight of Sunny Chan‘s tomb and was sorry for his premature death. Since Mak was wearing red underpants and ghosts tend to follow and adhere to red things, Mak was thus possessed..(n)

The contradictions in working style between Cheung and his superiors naturally lead to numerous scenes of strong conflicts..(n)

Dragon has him executed in public. But White Wolf No.2 in command, starts to challenge the old man. His two assistants, Joseph and Kirl, who intend to take over the narotic trade, set a trap for Tom, one of Dragon's six sons. In the melee, Kirl kills Dragon. Joseph persuades White Wolf to a massacre of the Dragon Family and the four 'families' during the funeral. At the same times, he kills White Wolf and sets his foot in the high society..(n)

programme.title: 契媽唔易做
programme.desc: A Chinese illegal immigrant “Cousin” wrongly trusted his friend Kwok to rob a jewellery shop. Kwok managed to escape and Cousin is so scared to hide himself in the vehicle which is rented by Ah Ching to remove to the rural area. Ah Ching is suffered by the high pressure from her work and city life. She also has to worry about her boyfriend Fai who is a police inspector. She is determined to pack up and move into remote area to escape from all this. She doesn't know a stranger (Cousin) is right at her back. Ah Ching meets with Pak Lam who is reared in the village by his greedy father Uncle Tat. Ah Ching finds it so ridiculous that naturally she sympathizes the kid. Pak Lam visits Ah Ching's new home to play TV games. He bumped into the scared Cousin who is still hiding there. He and Pak Lam come into an agreement not to reveal his identity to the others. Cousin has no attention to hurt anybody. He even stands out to protect Ah Ching and Pak Lam when the gangs in the village tr.(n)

programme.title: 君子好逑
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo..(n)

programme.title: 龍跨四海
programme.desc: SHIKO is brought up in a Japanese underworld family but lives with her mother in England after her parents' separation while her elder brother TARO stays with her father BUTA. In a business trip to Paris, SHIKO meets a Chinese illegal immigrant CHIN-SHUI who can only earn his living by working for the Chinatown triads. The stepping in of SHIKO brings a tremendous change to his life. After the assassination for the triads in Paris, CHIN-SHUI flees to England and stays with his Chinese friend, FA-CHIN, who always loves SHIKO. Both SHIKO and CHIN-SHUI fall in love. The company that SHIKO works for is owned by her father BUTA. Both BUTA and TARO discovers NAKAMURI's corrupt practices in their company..(n)

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 阿飛正傳
programme.desc: A self-obsessed man, desperately seeking his true identity, York plays carelessly with his lovers and his friends before leaving them all to the Philippines in search of the truth..(n)

programme.title: 至尊無上
programme.desc: Sam and Crab are a pair of skilled gamblers. When Sam chooses to leave the life, Crab engages the vengeful attention of Yakuza. The gangsters strike back by kidnapping Sam's girl..(n)

programme.title: The Whale Whisperer 第1季
programme.desc: This film follows the inspiring relationship between whale whisperer Vicki Neville and the\nhumpback whales of Australia. Never-before-seen behaviours have been documented by a team of five cinematographers over the three-month whale season in Hervey Bay, all captured in glorious 4K. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this week's episode Simon must grapple with a juggernaut that has skidded off the M62 and down a steep bank, but when they finally manage to pull it back onto the carriageway, it starts leaking diesel. Jim battles to rescue a car transporter stuck in a muddy layby, and his new best buddy, rookie driver Warren, faces a tricky tractor unit recovery on the side of a dual carriageway. Meanwhile, Rory must deal with a mobile library that’s been the victim of a shocking arson attack, and Fluff finds himself in a quandary in a quarry – rescuing a broken-down tipper truck.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Western Australia’s Murchison GeoRegion is well known for its’ ancient landscapes and\nbrilliant skies, this is the real outback. We take a journey through a region full of stories dating back to\nthe earth’s beginning, around 4½ billion years ago.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Part Two of our Kamilaroi Highway road-trip starts in Lightning Ridge and wraps up in\nBourke, and we’re blessed with more sensational countryside, and the awesome stories that make\nthis area of Australia so popular. This is a part of Australia everyone needs to discover.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken\nby European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in\nthe very interior of the country.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Central Victoria is ‘river & ranges country’, and is an easy drive out of Victoria’s capital, Melbourne. Epic scenery, outstanding natural beauty, lots of history, and down to earth hospitality, our road-trip through Central Victoria does not disappoint.

programme.sub-title: David Attenborough: A Life on Earth
programme.desc: The incredible journey and illustrious career of one of the most travelled men in history, this documentary tells the story of how Sir David Attenborough came to be the voice of modern natural history programs by bringing the natural world into our homes.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons 第6季
programme.desc: We go to the mail room for viewer requests as Terry and Larry take a look into famous scenes from Yellowstone, SWAT, Fast and Furious.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons 第6季
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test things they never got to from other episodes. Pull up a chair and get ready for leftovers, and a surprise guest.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第2季
programme.sub-title: In a Camp Down by the River
programme.desc: The Duck Camp Dinners crew leaves the bayous and heads down river to Venice, Louisiana where they prepare for their first duck hunt in the delta.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第2季
programme.desc: Blake shares a family recipe with the DCD crew, Chef Jean-Paul smokes ducks, and the crew heads out on a wild boar hunt in the marshes surrounding Venice.

programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. In this episode, we highlight some of the standout activities available to visitors in this incredible state. Traverse the pristine wilderness of K’gari, the world’s largest sand island, witness the humpback whale migration from the sheltered waters of Platypus Bay, and come face to face with Australia’s cutest animals at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary.

programme.title: Experience Australia 第1季
programme.desc: From the ancient mountains of the Flinders Ranges to the rocky shores of the Great Australian Bight, South Australia is a land brimming with culture, history and natural wonders. In this installment, we feature the premier experiences to be had in this wonderful destination. Step onto the vast salt flats of the Gawler Ranges, fish for wild salmon from the shimmering shores of the Eyre Peninsular, and experience an iconic train journey through the outback, onboard The Ghan.

programme.title: Gold Fever 第3季
programme.desc: On this episode of Gold Fever, we're in Alaska during the final days of the Cripple River Expidition. The summer is just about over for the crew, but Tom's season is just getting started. Part 1 of 2.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this week's episode Simon must grapple with a juggernaut that has skidded off the M62 and down a steep bank, but when they finally manage to pull it back onto the carriageway, it starts leaking diesel. Jim battles to rescue a car transporter stuck in a muddy layby, and his new best buddy, rookie driver Warren, faces a tricky tractor unit recovery on the side of a dual carriageway. Meanwhile, Rory must deal with a mobile library that’s been the victim of a shocking arson attack, and Fluff finds himself in a quandary in a quarry – rescuing a broken-down tipper truck.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季

programme.title: Tasting Tasmania 第1季
programme.desc: Ben Milbourne explores the infamous Salamana Market in Hobart where he speaks with local producers about their Fresh Tasmanian Produce. Ben spends his evening enjoying the Hobart nightlife.

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
To the uninitiated, a farmer’s toil is never-ending, hard, and against the elements. To the initiated like Chris however, that’s simply a misconception. 

Nature is elegant by design, everything has its place and purpose and nothing is wasted. There are lessons to be learnt from rain cycles and forest floor debris offer enriching take-aways.

So the question is how? How do we apply these principles of nature to the green projects we bring into our non-wild, non-natural, personal spaces.

香港有寶證
programme.desc: 香港碩果僅存的銅器店有80多年歷史，由兩兄弟同撈銅煲，打造世界級技術。香港功夫聞名全球，一代宗師承襲父志，將武學代代相傳；香港獨有紅Van水牌，保留數十年傳統，膠牌背後蘊藏了小巴業界行規。香港有位隱世製琴師，花了畢生心血打造出超靚聲小提琴.(n)

programme.title: 升級美食
programme.desc: 今集的主題食材是海蜇。海蜇是水母的一種，西方國家都幾乎不會用到這種食材。而對中餐而言，大多數都傾向作為涼拌菜式。這種被主持阿正戲言為「橡皮筋」的食材，可以如何融入西餐煮法當中，吃出新感覺？廚師Felix和Fai 將會接受這次挑戰！.(n)

立邦抗甲醛淨味兒童漆系列特約 : 空間改造王
programme.desc: 鹿兒島縣姶良市嘅町田家，八年前為咗細路可以健康快樂成長，於是搬到嚟有寬廣庭院嘅屋企。不過呢個庭院太寬廣喇，面積有成五千三百三十七呎，全家人除草，都趕唔上啲草嘅生長速度。再加上庭院排水不良，每次一落雨地面就積水，地面成日一片泥濘，而家呢度，成為害蟲同蛇.(n)

programme.desc: 美國洛杉機有家人為住宅問題煩惱，就是野野村家。呢位男士再次遠道而來，就是改造工匠版田基禎。野野村家，由於工作關係，爸爸回到家裡家人都已睡了，他會放輕腳步，避免發出聲音。將坐墊當係枕頭，這種於睡袋訓教的生活，已經持續了很多年了。嬌小的太太，不單止廚房枱.(n)

programme.title: 港式流行
programme.desc: 西營盤、上環都位在香港島的西部，西營盤是港島最早發展的住宅區以及學校區，老店很多，不管是餃子還是咖啡店，都是真材實料，一吃愛上。這次阿倫以及Andrea還來到上環的啤酒吧，選擇多樣，不管你偏好什麼口味，一定都會挑到你愛的，來到這兩區，不管你是喜愛老店.(n)

programme.title: 去邊啊Do姐
programme.desc: Do姐與嘉賓Tyson Yoshi 被維也納音樂之都的氛圍感染，也想翩翩地跳起維也納華爾茲。著名百年舞蹈學校的速成班，可以幫助他倆—尤其是Tyson—在衣香鬢影的舞會中脱穎而出嗎?告別華麗舞會，二人來到一扇小窗前，這裡號稱出售全世界最好的咖啡，在咖啡.(n)

programme.title: 去邊啊Do姐
programme.desc: 維也納是音樂之都，也是歐洲人文藝術的搖籃。Do姐和Tyson Yoshi 踏著音樂神童莫扎特、分離派畫家克林姆及精神分析之父弗洛依德的足跡，感受這片培育出無數曠世奇才的神奇土壤。莫扎特愛吃甚麼來滋養他的音樂細胞，克林姆如何以一吻留芳百世，弗洛依德靠飲.(n)

programme.desc: 之前幾集慧儀姐邀約了一眾圈中好友，今集破例邀請了兩位好閨蜜，Candy是藍帶廚藝高手，另一位Joe則是馬拉朋友，二人不但識飲識食，對馬來西亞事物更是瞭如指掌！Fish則馬不停蹄的跑了兩間特色馬拉餐廳，一間是食物色彩繽紛令人食指大動的創意馬拉菜...(n)

雷頓 不可思議偵探社 ～卡特莉的解謎事件簿～
升級美食
programme.desc: 來到最後一集！今集的主題食材是納豆。納豆是日本的國民美食，但對於大部分人而言，對這種食材的評價都是好壞參半。納豆除了拌飯吃外，還可以有什麼新食法？擅長印尼菜的Flora 和擅長中菜的Bosco 會如何將這種帶有強烈氣味的食材改頭換臉呢？.(n)

健康關注組
programme.desc: 香港人喜歡吃火鍋，冬天會吃得更頻密，醫生卻告訴大家，吃火鍋最容易引起痛風，為甚麼呢？痛風係因為尿酸。尿酸又是怎樣在人體出現？尿酸是怎樣引致痛風？所謂尿酸是不是真的酸性？坊間有傳聞說常喝鹼性水可以中和尿酸，有沒有科學根據？.(n)

programme.title: 全港開餐100強
programme.desc: 今集開餐推介：網民大讚的海南雞專門店，日日大排長龍，他們的雞、油飯及醬汁，美味到無得輸! 品嘗正宗意大利帕爾瑪菜式，炸 Burrata Cheese、意大利雲吞，款款都正! 正宗韓國菜，除了烤肉，還有即叩即劏的刺身，連活章魚都一樣食得到!勇記海南雞上.(n)

programme.sub-title: 第920集 在社區設立保護龜隻的教育基地，如何推動生命教育？
programme.desc: 「小球員過聖誕」. 每逢聖誕佳節，家長們都頭痛如何為小朋友安排節日活動。為鼓勵小朋友多做運動，有足球學校舉辦聖誕足球訓練營，一連3天教小朋友踢足球技巧，並訓練他們的心理質素，送上特別的聖誕禮物。今個節日，一起陪小球員踢住足球過聖誕!. #聖誕#足球#訓練營#運動#禮物#阮頌陽. 「救龜護龜，社區齊發揮」 . 有機構在西貢合辦社區教育基地，收容各式水陸龜入住，鼓勵街坊接觸動物和大自然，並招募小義工學習如何照顧龜類，實踐保護動物和尊重生命的精神！ . #西貢#龜#教育#動物#大自然#梁凱寧#徐頴堃. 「雙軌人生Plus -配音大師跑過界(上)」. 你未必知道她的名字，但肯定聽過她的聲音。由動畫主角到一線女星，周恩恩聲演的角色之多，就正如她涉獵的範疇一樣。既是配音員，又是配音導演和導師，更開公司做老闆，近年愛上跑步，又有甚麼原因呢？. #動畫#配音#導師#跑步#周恩恩#張嘉儀.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第四集曹星如/跑者背後. 〈跑者愛分享〉－曹星如. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與「神奇小子」曹星如（Rex）從紅隧口跑到中環摩天輪，探索港島海濱的熱門打卡點！Rex分享他在拳擊與跑步的共同領悟，強調呼吸節奏的重要性，慢下來才能更好地收放自如。昔日孤身擂臺的他，如今與Inez奔跑中並肩暢談：「無論擂台或跑道，努力付出超越自己進步！」. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－做好擺手，可免受傷？. 跑步不只是腳步，擺手姿勢也很重要！錯誤的擺手容易造成膝蓋與關節受傷。正確方法是雙臂貼近身體，上擺至胸口、下擺至腰部，像鐘擺般前後擺動。搭配彈力帶訓練，強化肌肉力量，跑得更安全、更有效率！. 〈跑者背後〉. 香港跑界流傳一句金句：「無獎都要有相！」每場跑步比賽背後，都有賴大量義工通力合作，更少不了攝影師沿途為跑手捕捉珍貴的回憶。作為跑步義工的蘇永權，以及經營跑步相片平台的林志倫，他們究竟如何投入這些幕後工作，默默為跑壇貢獻呢.(n)

programme.title: 優遊記精華遊
programme.desc: 粗獷主義建築以其裸露的結構、粗糙的材料和強烈的幾何形態，在二十世紀建築設計中別樹一幟。建築師兼攝影師麥憬淮與主持Kay李凱翹邊走邊說，漫遊赤柱聖士提反書院及香港中文大學，以建築師的專業視角與攝影師的細膩觀察，帶大家細味粗獷建築的設計特色、空間美學及背後的故事.(n)

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 本地兩間提供公共服務的大型企業，近年積極聘請殘疾人士作為員工，致力打造傷健共融的職場環境。. 歷史悠久的巴士公司，於不同部門為殘疾人士提供工作崗位，例如餐飲及園藝部主力由輕度智障的員工打理，而失物組及錢箱組亦可見聽障員工的身影。巴士公司多年來跟社企、特殊訓練學校等緊密合作，為殘疾人仕創造及提供多元化的工作機會。. 已成立五十年、為輕度智障人仕提供多項職業培訓的社福機構匡智會，近年跟巴士公司有不同形式的合作，於殘疾人仕就業方面同屬重要推手。. 成立超過一百六十年的煤氣公司，於僱用傷殘人士方面有豐富經驗，其中客戶服務部聘請了數位使用輪椅的僱員。煤氣公司總部大樓的多項設施亦經過悉心設計，為輪椅使用者提供無障礙的工作環境.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十集：胡兵為追逃犯出意外
programme.desc: 秦川得知胡兵為了追逃犯出了意外，悲從中來，與胡兵徹底釋懷。2000年春節，刑偵專家武英德到緒城市局講課，與秦川就松林縣一個案件進行了一段激烈的討論，更收了秦川為徒。此時，葉茂生的案子又起了變故，秦川向武英德求助，從中對作為執法者又有了新的領悟.(n)

學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集嘉賓在武術界，可以說是享負盛名，獲獎無數，她曾經五次獲得香港傑出運動員的殊榮。所謂：「太極生兩儀，兩儀生四象」，她當過電影武術指導，同時又是一位桃李滿門的武術老師，我們請來著名武術運動員李暉談談她的太極人生。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 嘉賓：. 李暉(武術運動員). #太極人生#李暉#學人沙龍#米哈#黃仲遠.(n)

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2 - 回歸森林
programme.desc: 當年邁的「公雞甲蟲」年華老去，再也無法啼唱時，所有人都為毛毛感到憂心忡忡。「公雞」是毛毛最親密的夥伴。儘管他嘴上總說著「我沒事」，卻掩飾不了內心的悲傷。看著故作堅強的他，菇菇們決定伸出援手，讓他明白：流露真情實感，並不是軟弱的表現.(n)

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: 馬克及其摯友Jeng均有弱視，他們是一所盲人學校的學生。有一天，Jeng看見馬克觀看抖音的DJ影片，便鼓勵馬克拍片，但馬克猶豫。Jeng所有朋友都想拍片，但只有馬克的電話可上網。馬克在朋友的要求下答應拍片，但條件是他只擔任攝影師，而不會在片中出現。. 他們一起上傳了首段影片，吸引了大量觀眾及支持者。他們招募更多朋友參與，並成功製作了很多影片。Jeng希望觀眾亦見到馬克，於是偷拍他，令馬克感到不舒服。馬克試圖取回電話但Jeng抗拒，令電話掉下，一切歡樂告終。. 沒有人知道馬克心裏有陰影，害怕在表演時被人取笑。老師在班上叫馬克唸詩，他遲疑和默不作聲。他的朋友突然開始打拍子，就像拍片時一樣，馬克最終完成表演，這次沒有人笑他，只有歡呼喝彩聲.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
藝坊
programme.sub-title: Theatresports, Dream Rooms@M+ & in the studio: The Saffron
programme.desc: Even for the non-religious, Christmas is one of the best times for many to come together with families and friends. The Arab World is home to some of the world’s oldest Christian communities. Later on the show, the local band The Saffron will be playing us some traditional Middle Eastern music. But first, a new form of sports, and one that may come as a surprise to you. It’s called Theatresports, and it is an artistic form developed in Canada. . At M+ you can catch an immersive exhibition of twelve environments created by women artists between the 1950s and the present day. Three of those environments are newly commissioned works by Asian women. Titled “Dream Rooms”, this selection of works was first staged in 2023 at Haus der Kunst in Munich, Germany. The travelling exhibition on show at M+ is the first edition in Asia. Audience engagement is an active part of the experience, so shoes off and dive in.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - IP 新機遇
programme.desc: 一個以瀕危動物為靈感的香港原創手袋品牌，憑着生動造型與實用設計，逐步走向國際市場。人氣提升的同時，品牌亦面對山寨產品湧現，影響銷售及品牌形象。. 本集將了解品牌如何透過外觀設計註冊，守護創意成果；又如何憑藉法律保障，維持產品獨特性，讓更多原創動物造型手袋得以安心誕生，繼續在世界各地展現香港設計的魅力.(n)

programme.sub-title: 第十六集：遇上工程專家馮辛
programme.desc: 在冰天雪地中，七連艱難跋涉，途中重傷戰士相繼犧牲。萬里目睹戰友離去，迅速成長。途中遇到逃亡的工程專家馮辛，誤以為是逃兵，後知其正協助三連作戰。七連受命增援三連，與美軍激烈交火。三連連長告知七連，必須摧毀美軍退路水壩橋，阻止敵軍撤退.(n)

programme.desc: 網絡名人，又叫大V 。在網絡發達的社會，大V可以輕易接觸大眾，類型更是各種各樣，而他們靠的，就是粉絲。其實，粉絲文化源遠流長，粉絲為什麼願意為偶像付出心力？偶像一句說話，為什麼又可以令粉絲為之瘋狂呢？. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 蕭欣浩(大學講師). 吳沚默(作者、編劇). #大V #粉絲文化#網絡文化#流量#學人沙龍.(n)

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：荷里活電影音樂之夜
programme.desc: 今個聖誕假期，我們將會帶領觀眾們前往丹麥電台音樂廳，經歷一場璀璨的荷里活電影音樂之旅。丹麥國家交響樂團夥拍廣受歡迎的女孩合唱團「DR Junior Choir」，以及才華洋溢的年輕歌唱家，一同演奏多首膾炙人口的荷里活電影音樂。當中包括：《鐵達尼號》、《加勒比海盜》、《護花傾情》、《侏羅紀公園》及《E.T.》等等。另外，音樂會亦加設了一個特備環節，向出色的奧斯卡電影配樂致敬。想在佳節與親朋摯愛，安坐家中欣賞一場音樂盛宴，便不能錯過《荷里活電影之夜》音樂會。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2024年12月28日 星期六 中午1時 . DR Koncerthuset rolls out the red carpet for a sparkling Hollywood gala with the DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir, Andrea Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyratnam. The audience awaits a musical firework display from the best Hollywood films such as “Titanic”, "Pirates of the Caribbean", " The Bodyguard”, “Jurassic Park”and "E.T." - and many more. The evening also features a special section dedicated to the best music from the iconic Oscars. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2024.12.28 SAT 1:00pm.(n)

programme.desc: 一連四集，每集一個主題，令觀眾欣賞精彩表演之餘，更能了解學生對音樂的熱情和努力不懈的精神。. 第二集：《管弦篇》. 1.通利琴行鋼琴獨奏獎學金聖保羅書院徐梓辰. Rhapsodie in Eb Op 119 No 4 - Johannes Brahms. 2.弦樂公開組聖保羅男女中學裴紫軒. Violin Concerto in D Op 6 - 1st movement - Niccolò Paganini. 3.小學管樂團十三歲或以下拔萃女小學. Into the Storm - Robert W.Smith. 4.通利琴行鋼琴室樂獎中學拔萃男書院. Piano Quartet in Eb Op 47 - 4th movement - Robert Schumann. 5.中學混聲合唱團外文歌曲第二組別初級組十五歲或以下. 本年度最佳中學初級組合唱團第二組別迦密柏雨中學. Tortoise Moon - Robert S. Cohen.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
《科學 ∙創未來3》
programme.sub-title: 第五集《科學的火種：營運卓越獎項的藝術》
programme.desc: 科學日新月異，塑造未來面貌。當我們盡享應用科技帶來的便利之際，可曾駐足思索：奠基一切的基礎科學，究竟源自何人、何種洞見？. 本集直擊未來科學大獎十週年特別專場，主題為「如何營運一個科學獎項？」，雲集國際頂尖科學家共襄盛舉。「基礎科學」探究宇宙起源、物質本質與生命機制，雖抽象卻影響深遠；「應用科學」則如接力賽般承接成果，轉化為醫學、工程與電子科技，改善人類生活。眾多重要科學獎項之所以聚焦基礎研究，正因其開啟無盡可能。. 究竟如何營運一個具公信力與長遠影響的科學獎項？節目邀請岑浩璋教授擔任導讀，與觀眾一同聆聽頂尖科學家分享遴選機制、公正原則及人才激勵的實務智慧。一個卓越獎項，即是點燃科學火種的關鍵.(n)

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.sub-title: 鍾意食「細蓉」的緬甸阿哥
programme.desc: 31歲的 Sai Htong Kham溫文爾雅，一派學者風範。他來自緬甸，自稱「佛教徒」，但會喝酒吃肉，只是更喜歡追求靈性與精神生活。十年前，Kham從緬甸來到香港讀大學，之後唸碩士、做研究助理，現在是博士研究生，十年都在學術的「象牙塔」中度過。. Kham感謝香港開拓了他的眼界，將他從昔日緬甸的窮鄉僻壤帶到現代化的國際都市。他也學會了回饋，加入了一個幫助難民的民間機構，在繁忙的學術生涯中為他們提供協助。初到香港的頭幾年，Kham很不習慣，這裏很少緬甸人，也找不到家鄉的餐廳，每次回國探望父母之後都不願回來。但現在香港確實他的家園，他強調是家園，不是第二家園。他掛念這裏的「細蓉」雲吞面、便利、人情世故，每次到海外參加學術會議都想儘快趕回來。. 大部分緬甸人都是彿教徒。生活在香港，Kham喜歡逛廟宇，在香火繚繞之處找到清淨與精神的滿足。從緬甸來到香港，Kham需要物質生活也渴望靈性的追求，他在這裡找到了這種共融的可能。. 今集主持愛美Omme和吳.(n)

programme.title: 森動香港
programme.desc: 今集回顧香港植樹歷史，從參觀香港植物標本室收藏的百年前樹木標本，檢視城市老照片中的路邊樹，再到香港郊野公園的大棠苗圃，認識郊野公園的植林歷史，繼而展望未來的植林研究方案，理解原來每棵樹木背後都是無數人，經年累月，默默耕耘的成果.(n)

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 氣氛好怎能讓它停止?今集繼續請來黃淑蔓及應智越做嘉賓。他們除了帶來新作外，更會分享自己廣東歌歌單。難得可以跟歌迷近距離接觸，我們更邀請歌迷上來玩遊戲，考驗二人畫功。. 主持：阮頌陽、周卓盈. 歌曲：. 《大絕》(應智越). 《You're Gone》(應智越). 《已刪除的時間線》(黃淑蔓).(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - IP 新機遇
programme.sub-title: 凍能生巧 無電製冷技術
programme.desc: 一間源自本地大學實驗室的創科公司，致力發展一種無電製冷技術，三年間增長迅速，由最初的油漆塗料發展至地磚、薄膜以及紡織品等多樣化產品。. 本集將了解他們如何善用專利保護，為核心技術帶來穩妥保障，令公司科研發展之路可以走得更快更遠.(n)

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 單車港隊在多個國際賽事上表現亮眼，在剛過去的全運賽事中，李思穎更勇奪三面金牌的佳績，是極受市民追捧的運動項目之一。除了最令人印象深刻的公路及場地單車賽，山地車項目同樣在近年備受關注。. 歌手應智越（細貓）決定拿出他的「第一次」，跟教練在多變地形、崎嶇不平的山地，學習如何駕馭山地車。就連轉波、煞車都要重頭學起，細貓又是否能成功挑戰山地車這項運動.(n)

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.desc: 為躲避糾纏，Donovan誤闖Pam的房間，兩人被迫共度一夜。尷尬互動中，Pam窺見他孤獨的內心。同時，外公因撞見母親的新家庭而氣急病發，急需高額手術費卻拒絕幫助，讓Pam陷入絕境。此時，Donovan遞出橄欖枝，並非憐憫，而是認可她的能力，正式邀請她成為自己的經理人。這場危機，竟成了兩人關係與現實困境的意外轉機.(n)

programme.title: 周末大電影：聖誕快樂
programme.desc: 報館採訪主任麥尚(麥嘉飾)，在平安夜的生辰，只有兒子光頭仔陪伴，使他加倍思念逝去的妻子。在大兒子及女兒的鼓勵下，終向隔鄰的女歌手小鳳(徐小鳳飾)展開追求，而小鳳亦對麥尚有相當好感，不料小鳳的表哥剛好從美國返港，並有意娶她作過埠新娘。除夕前一晚，小鳳和麥尚口角，小鳳竟答應下嫁表哥。除夕晚，一對對情侶使麥尚百感交集，此時小鳳出現在眼前.(n)

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.desc: 香港網球公開賽，1月4日至11日會於維多利亞公園網球主場舉行，為ATP賽季揭開序幕。香港一哥黃澤林同時出戰單打和雙打，於主場迎戰一眾球星。. 單打賽事會有四位世界排名前20球手，分別為去年打入八強的意大利球手姆錫迪、首度參戰哈薩克的布力克、2024年冠軍俄羅斯的盧比利夫以及他雙打的好拍檔卡真洛夫。全運會男單冠軍、四強擊敗黃澤林的吳易昺，以及全運銀牌得主內地新星商竣程都會出戰.(n)

programme.title: 悅讀憲法
programme.sub-title: 教育願景：憲法下的學習使命
programme.desc: 在國家的發展進程中，教育不可或缺。《憲法》第二十三條強調，要培養為社會主義服務的各類專業人才，發揮知識分子在現代化建設中的作用。《憲法》如何為教育事業提供制度保障，推動香港學校培育國家發展的重要人才？節目走訪九龍真光中學，了解該校如何透過課程設計與多元活動培育學生，實踐憲法所賦予的教育使命，培養具愛國精神與社會責任感的新一代.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 本港平均壽命全球名列前茅，但長壽同樣帶來挑戰。以65歲退休年齡計算，意味退休時需要擁有近20年的資金應付開支。有調查指，近七成港人擔心退休「無錢駛」。坊間林林總總的投資產品，是否適合長者購買? 怎樣才可退休無憂? 今集會請來理財專家教路，「精明」長者亦會分享他們的理財之道.(n)

programme.title: 有葯
programme.desc: 左雲起擔心徐涓的功力與奇毒，林開認為背後必有更大組織，建議樓主利用論壇情報。樓主懶得行動，讓左雲起和謝涼分頭調查。皇帝從小雪那裡獲得知識，留她在宮中，並命人取更多穿越者資料。豫王那邊，李克得知豫王的弑君計畫，央求豫王帶他散心.(n)

programme.title: 時事摘錄
programme.desc: 今集內容:. -李家超︰港深創新科技園服務大灣區邁向國際. -宏福苑大火｜麥美娟：委任管理人非剝奪業主權力. -「粵車南下」入市區首日100名額近乎爆滿. -中九龍繞道(油麻地段)通車首個工作日大致暢順. -海關拘5人涉洗黑錢近89億港元. -入境處數字:聖誕日共有超過125萬2千人次經各管制站出入境. -諾和工程公司9人被捕警檢45張偽造證書. -公院病理學檢驗推共付模式大部分檢查免費. -港大團隊：聖誕新年較易傳播甲流籲盡快打疫苗. -聖誕市面情況.(n)

programme.title: 藝坊
programme.sub-title: Theatresports, Dream Rooms@M+ & in the studio: The Saffron
programme.desc: Even for the non-religious, Christmas is one of the best times for many to come together with families and friends. The Arab World is home to some of the world’s oldest Christian communities. Later on the show, the local band The Saffron will be playing us some traditional Middle Eastern music. But first, a new form of sports, and one that may come as a surprise to you. It’s called Theatresports, and it is an artistic form developed in Canada. . At M+ you can catch an immersive exhibition of twelve environments created by women artists between the 1950s and the present day. Three of those environments are newly commissioned works by Asian women. Titled “Dream Rooms”, this selection of works was first staged in 2023 at Haus der Kunst in Munich, Germany. The travelling exhibition on show at M+ is the first edition in Asia. Audience engagement is an active part of the experience, so shoes off and dive in.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 舌尖上的中國 (第四季)
programme.desc: 本集節目選了七個飲食文化迥異的國家：美國、秘魯、英國、法國、新加坡、馬來西亞、印尼。展現巧手的華人，如何憑藉廣泛的取材、精湛的烹飪技術、以及融會變通的智慧，讓深厚的中華飲饌文化落地生根.(n)

programme.title: 香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.desc: 香港三面環海，蘊藏豐富的生態寶藏，是潛水愛好者的天堂。. 年逾八十的熊秉寬（熊Sir），自小熱愛潛水和攝影。於潛水未普及的年代，熊Sir已和好友一起下潛探索。於六十年代，他更用菲林攝錄機，紀錄鮮為人知的水底世界。一大遍魚群翩翩暢游的震撼景象，至今依然令他畢生難忘。. 同樣熱愛海洋的佘國豪（Stan），於2014年與朋友共同發起「114˚E珊瑚魚普查企劃」。他帶領一群義務潛水員，走訪香港珊瑚魚棲息地，悉心紀錄牠們的行蹤。團隊至今已發現超過五十種官方文獻未曾於香港水域發現過的品種，大大肯定了本地海洋的生態價值。Stan的同事姚偉康作為魚類愛好者，正在為計劃整理過去十年的資料並輯錄成圖鑒，希望讓更多人認識我們海底下的鄰居。. 這班熱愛大海的潛水員，樂於在水中暢遊，並為大家呈獻眼底下的水世界。. 編導：嚴珮盈. 監製：楊慧雅. 播映日期：2025年12月22日(星期一)晚上8時港台電視31.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 澳門雙行線
programme.sub-title: 第十一集 博眾物 慢品味
programme.desc: 中西融匯的城市，得天獨厚的歷史文化，讓澳門不僅茶的品種多，而且食材非常豐富，五湖四海的人聚集在這裏，把天南海北的食材發揮得淋漓盡致。選擇喜歡的茶，品嚐令人驚嘆的茶點和美食，享受那份慢悠悠的怡然自得.(n)

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 沼田町是北海道稻米重鎮之一，現在迎來碩果累累的秋天。我們和兩名北聯女子田徑部成員，一起體驗種植稻米最興奮的環節－收割。沼田町引以為傲的新米美味到難以忘懷.(n)

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2 - 難忘的一天
programme.desc: 杏鮑仔有一種不祥的預感。他總覺得自己忘了某件至關重要的事。當記憶的碎片終於拼湊完整，他明白了那股不安的源頭——菇菇鎮即將遭受一群飢餓木蟲的侵襲！築起防禦工程！我們必須拯菇菇鎮.(n)

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2 - 回歸森林
programme.desc: 當年邁的「公雞甲蟲」年華老去，再也無法啼唱時，所有人都為毛毛感到憂心忡忡。「公雞」是毛毛最親密的夥伴。儘管他嘴上總說著「我沒事」，卻掩飾不了內心的悲傷。看著故作堅強的他，菇菇們決定伸出援手，讓他明白：流露真情實感，並不是軟弱的表現.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 佛羅里達州 - 另一個荷里活
programme.desc: 《音樂旅人》前往荷里活，不過並非滿街電影明星片場的那個，我們要探索的那個城市，同樣名叫「荷里活」，位於佛羅里達洲。佛羅里達州經常被其南方的耀眼鄰居邁亞密海灘遮蓋了光芒，但這裡的荷里活要世界知道，它自有特色之處吸引遊客，以音樂說故事，同時建立更強大的社區。我們發覺無論去世界上任何地方，只要略為發掘一下，總會發現到豐富的音樂寶庫。我們在佛羅里達州荷里活的時候，適逢西班牙探險家環龐斯德利昂來佛五百週年，西班牙天王級巨星安東里奧卡莫納也在參與慶典，我們與他傾談，看他演出；我們又和從音樂中找到靈感的壁畫藝術家李珀見面，到訪古巴雪茄店，訪問本地音樂人艾廸巴爾佐拉，也到了美國最高檔齊全的鼓店見識。旅途中我們嘗試了荷里活美食，享用海灘美景以及精彩夜生活。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月1日 星期二晚，10時30分 Music Voyager heads to Hollywood. Not the one with movie stars and film studios, we're exploring the other city called Hollywood. .in Florida. Hollywood, Florida is often overshadowed by its flashier neighbor to the south, Miami Beach. Yet this Hollywood has been letting the world know that it has something special to offer visitors and it is using music to tell its story…and build a stronger community at the same time. We've always been fascinated by the ways in which you can visit almost anyplace in the world and with a little digging find a harvest of musical riches. Our adventures in Hollywood, Florida include a conversation and performance with Spanish superstar Antonio Carmona who is in town for the Viva Florida 500 concert commemorating the arrival of Spanish explorer Ponce de Leon, a chat with renowned music-inspired muralist and painter Lebo, a Cuban cigar bar escapade with local musician Eddie Balzola and a visit to Resurrection Drums, one of the country’s premier drum shops. Along the way we discover Hollywood’s cuisine, beaches and thriving nightlife. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.1 TUE 10:30pm.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 佛羅里達州邁阿密 - 魔幻之城
programme.desc: 邁阿密這個城市，每個人都認得，真正懂得的卻很少。對於這城的熣燦霓虹燈光、滿佈型格度假酒店的黃金海灘，大家都不會陌生，不過這城市的脈搏，卻是藏於住在其中的多元種族文化社區。我們發掘了強勁明亮的邁阿密電子舞曲，也有幸欣賞其拉丁海地曲風，先後和阿福羅貝塔、斯帕姆群星、T-VICE以及「為珍發狂」等歌手組合見面分享。旅程中我們暢飲古巴咖啡，踏單車遊遍色彩繽紛的壁畫藝術區，吃嚇人的哥倫比亞熱狗，享受這城日夜不斷的創意活力。邁阿密鮮為人知的一面，即將為你揭開。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月1日 星期二晚，11時00分 Miami is a city that everyone recognizes but few truly know. We’re familiar with its neon glow and beaches lined with golden sands and art deco hotels, but the heartbeat of the city lies in the vibrant multi-cultural communities that call this city home. We explore the fiery sounds of Miami’s electronic dance music scene as well as its Latin and Haitian grooves, with Afrobeta, The Spam All Stars, T-Vice and Locos Por Juana. We get buzzed on Cuban coffee, tour the colorful mural district by bike and take on the daunting Colombian hot dog, enjoying the spontaneous creativity and color that keeps the city pulsing day and night. This is Miami like you have never seen, or heard, before. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.1 TUE 11:00pm.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: According to the Hong Kong Samaritans' 2023 suicide statistics, there were 1,092 suicide deaths, with 711 male cases—the highest in a decade. Males outnumbered females in suicide rates. Societal expectations place immense pressure on men, which continues to grow. Hong Kong’s latest life expectancy data shows men live 82.5 years, five years less than women’s 87.9. Men’s stress and mental health involve complex social, economic, and cultural factors. Addressing this requires societal support, shifting traditional norms, providing mental health resources, and promoting healthier lifestyles.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - IP 新機遇
programme.sub-title: 凍能生巧 無電製冷技術
programme.desc: 一間源自本地大學實驗室的創科公司，致力發展一種無電製冷技術，三年間增長迅速，由最初的油漆塗料發展至地磚、薄膜以及紡織品等多樣化產品。. 本集將了解他們如何善用專利保護，為核心技術帶來穩妥保障，令公司科研發展之路可以走得更快更遠.(n)

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Traces of fascinating animals at Lung Fu Shan
programme.desc: Located in the Central and Western District of Hong Kong, Lung Fu Shan is a mountain peak that stands at an elevation of 253 meters. It wasn't until 1998 that the government officially designated the surrounding area as Lung Fu Shan Country Park, which is also the smallest country park in Hong Kong. . Despite its small size, Lung Fu Shan Country Park is full of character. For instance, the park features the historic Pinewood Battery, which is listed as a Grade II historic buildings in Hong Kong and serves as a reminder of Battle of Hong Kong history during the past. . In addition to its cultural heritage, the park is also rich in ecological diversity. The streams within the park are home to various organisms, including freshwater prawns and stream crabs. By observing carefully, visitors may also spot traces of wildlife such as porcupines, masked palm civets, and short-nosed fruit bats within the park.(n)

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：眾戰士回憶往事添傷感
programme.desc: 肖長貴中彈，但幸運地被象棋擋住。炮排彈藥耗盡，老柴在取炮彈時犧牲。美軍撤退，計劃利用空軍優勢再攻。七連成功佔領死鷹嶺並清理戰場，面對殘存的美軍反擊，認命回憶起與愛人的約定。美軍轟炸機在外面盤旋，七連在坑洞內休整期間，各人的回憶湧現.(n)

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：李大耕帶戰士堅守死鷹嶺
programme.desc: 布雷登指揮美軍撤退並呼叫空軍支援，再次佔領死鷹嶺。千里為犧牲的戰友悲痛，夜襲奪回陣地。面對美軍重火力，長貴和青眼冒險端火力點，青眼更用生命暴露敵方狙擊手位置。通訊員春生帶來新任務，七連需南下炸毀橋樑，三排排長李大耕自願留下阻擊敵人.(n)

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 我們從《山海經》中的奇異世界談起，追溯泛靈信仰如何成為古人理解自然、解釋異象的載體，探討「怪力亂神」如何與政治權力、社會恐慌及地方傳說緊密交織，以漢武帝晚年的「巫蠱之禍」為核心案例，剖析對巫術的恐懼，如何能在信息不透明的宮廷政治中，引發巨大的風暴。. 主持:. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 謝偉傑(香港中文大學歷史系副教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授).(n)

programme.title: 貝多芬的鋼琴世界
programme.sub-title: 第十一集 : 第三十二鋼琴奏鳴曲 (張韜)/ 第二十九鋼琴奏鳴曲 (黃家正)
programme.desc: 貝多芬為世界帶來重大影響，有人為貝多芬冠以「古典音樂界的樂聖」的美譽，耹聽他的作品，能感受他那份不屈的意志，從而為生活注入正面力量。. 香港電台夥拍香港演藝學院，並聯同三十二位演藝鋼琴家，帶觀眾進入貝多芬的鋼琴世界。. 本集為觀眾挑選了以下作品：. C小調第三十二鋼琴奏鳴曲，作品111，第一樂章：莊嚴地(張韜). 降B大調第二十九鋼琴奏鳴曲，作品106，「大鍵琴」，第四樂章：廣板—賦格(黃家正). . 張韜在斯洛伐克的亨麥爾國際鋼琴比賽中獲得冠軍，並獲最佳演繹亨麥爾作品獎；1997年得到維納莫特國際鋼琴賽的冠軍，是首位獲該獎項的華人。. 黃家正於2014年曾入圍吉娜．巴考爾國際鋼琴比賽準決賽及於首爾年輕音樂家遴選中勝出。2019巴塞隆拿第65屆瑪莉亞‧卡納爾斯國際鋼琴比賽中奪得季軍。他的音樂歷程曾在得獎紀錄片《音樂人生》中記錄下來.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
盛事傳城
programme.desc: 香港網球公開賽，1月4日至11日會於維多利亞公園網球主場舉行，為ATP賽季揭開序幕。香港一哥黃澤林同時出戰單打和雙打，於主場迎戰一眾球星。. 單打賽事會有四位世界排名前20球手，分別為去年打入八強的意大利球手姆錫迪、首度參戰哈薩克的布力克、2024年冠軍俄羅斯的盧比利夫以及他雙打的好拍檔卡真洛夫。全運會男單冠軍、四強擊敗黃澤林的吳易昺，以及全運銀牌得主內地新星商竣程都會出戰.(n)

programme.title: 保監有道 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 保监局Cindy怀疑有无牌中介人诱骗年轻人购买保单，主动向上司 Brian建议自己以「卧底」方式进行调查。此案成功搜证之时，另一边厢却有其他求助人声称被骗….(n)

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 《港樂‧講樂 Pop Up》繼續走入人群，讓廣東歌以貼地方式走近觀眾。今集人氣歌手吳啟洋(Phoebus)為觀眾帶來愛得小心翼翼的《漸漸地》以及失戀情歌《孤獨先生》，以真摯歌聲呈現內心世界。嘉賓主持林智樂則帶來重新演繹的彭羚經典《完全因你》，以男聲演繹女歌，展現不一樣的情感層次。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 嘉賓主持. 林智樂. 歌曲：. 《完全因你》. 《漸漸地》. 《孤獨先生.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - IP 新機遇
programme.desc: 「IP 經濟」指知識產權（Intellectual Property）的商業化應用，是一種將原創動漫角色、故事等轉化為商品、授權等的商業模式。香港一家創意工作室，多年來透過取得版權授權，舉辦眾多深受市民大眾歡迎的展覽和活動。. 本集將從「超級聯繫人」及被授權方的角度，了解更多對知識產權保護的重要性，及探討香港發展「IP 經濟」的潛力和經濟影響.(n)

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 東華三院旗下營運的第一間社企餐廳，今年迎來15歲生日。由實驗，試行，開張到擴張，這些年來，讓大眾了解到社企不用靠光環，也能靠實力取勝。他們的烘焙工房、餐廳、麵包店，招聘超過六成殘疾員工。他們能發揮才能之餘，也能享受工作的每一刻.(n)

programme.title: 優遊記
programme.desc: #27城市建築印記. 【地膽導賞團】歷史建築活化重生. 香港特殊的歷史背景，遺留許多見證軍事與城市發展的建築群。這次旅程將探索與昔日「域多利駐地」關係密切的兩幢舊軍事建築──半山舊英軍醫院及堅尼地道蒙哥瑪利樓。兩者同屬愛德華時代古典復興風格，外觀和空間皆透視了它們在歷史上的重要角色，活化保育後則延續其社會價值，與社區的持續共生。. 【邊走邊說】無街之城. 「天橋城市」是香港新市鎮的獨特景觀，塑造香港新一代的生活空間。建築師陸匡願(Herman)與你「邊走邊說」將軍澳，細看大量天橋貫穿連接的都市，如何實現空間無縫交接，架空平台花園作為天橋的延伸，便利生活；斜坡式公園則令空間上下呼應，打破傳統橋底公園的印象。. 【都市漫遊】因地制宜的建築美學. 香港地少人多，加上地形限制，令城市發展出高效能、高活力的綜合性建築模式。建築師、築展人以大型私人屋苑美孚新邨、太古城，以及公屋彩虹邨為例，觀察香港建築如何將限制轉化為力量，塑造獨一無二的城市面貌。透過觀察建築與規劃，認識設計背後的價值觀，令人思考城市綠化與氣候變化等未來挑戰。. 【旅遊達人同你傾】墨西哥遊歷魔法小鎮仙人掌高過人. 旅遊記者洪慧冰早前在拉丁美洲旅居一年半，單是墨西哥便留了半年，從北到南遊遍火山、沙漠、美墨邊境、現代化首都、多個魔法小鎮……. 旅程過後，她最懷念墨西哥美食，包括Tacos以及各地各有不同的粟米餅類食物、各種衝擊味蕾的辣椒、餘韻強勁的甜酸甘Mole醬等，難忘的還有本地團遇上的熱情墨西哥人、一起遊歷的西班牙文同學、好客的當地人……. 主持：Jumbo曾淑雅. 嘉賓主持：洪慧冰.(n)

programme.title: 周末大電影 : 海外特派員
programme.desc: At the beginning of 1939, Jones, an American reporter, is sent by his paper to Europe. There, he is to investigate the possibility of a world war. In London, he meets an elderly Dutch politician, co-signatory of a secret alliance treaty whose details the Nazis will stop at nothing to discover. The old man is kidnapped.(n)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 冬瓜，有著冬天的名字，在仍冷冷的天氣下培苗，數個月後成為炎炎夏日幫助消暑解熱的理想食材。今集兩位「識食專員」探訪有機農場，了解冬瓜漫長的種植過程，並親身體驗收割的樂趣，又即場品嚐冬瓜的「生吃」美味。. 提到冬瓜料理，大家可能首先想到冬瓜盅。不過，廚師主持Andy 用創意烹調一道「日式麻婆冬瓜」，令嘉賓胡渭康和盧儷文中醫師吃得滋味。不少人以為冬瓜寒涼不宜冬天吃，但胡渭康就介紹一款他常做的食法，盧醫師也大讚適宜秋冬進食，究竟胡渭康的冬瓜飲食心得是什麼？. 主持：羅鈺文(Yuki)、Andy Dark. 嘉賓：胡渭康、盧儷文（註冊中醫.(n)

programme.title: 有葯
programme.desc: 左雲起無意發現豫王的弑君計畫，豫王欲殺他，卻被送往神秘洞穴與李克同行。左雲起和李克在洞穴中發現自稱拓荒組的穿越者在收集現代技術，他們的聖典是失蹤的《未來的到來》。左雲起決定隱瞞身份深入調查.(n)

programme.title: 優遊記
programme.desc: #27城市建築印記. 【地膽導賞團】歷史建築活化重生. 香港特殊的歷史背景，遺留許多見證軍事與城市發展的建築群。這次旅程將探索與昔日「域多利駐地」關係密切的兩幢舊軍事建築──半山舊英軍醫院及堅尼地道蒙哥瑪利樓。兩者同屬愛德華時代古典復興風格，外觀和空間皆透視了它們在歷史上的重要角色，活化保育後則延續其社會價值，與社區的持續共生。. 【邊走邊說】無街之城. 「天橋城市」是香港新市鎮的獨特景觀，塑造香港新一代的生活空間。建築師陸匡願(Herman)與你「邊走邊說」將軍澳，細看大量天橋貫穿連接的都市，如何實現空間無縫交接，架空平台花園作為天橋的延伸，便利生活；斜坡式公園則令空間上下呼應，打破傳統橋底公園的印象。. 【都市漫遊】因地制宜的建築美學. 香港地少人多，加上地形限制，令城市發展出高效能、高活力的綜合性建築模式。建築師、築展人以大型私人屋苑美孚新邨、太古城，以及公屋彩虹邨為例，觀察香港建築如何將限制轉化為力量，塑造獨一無二的城市面貌。透過觀察建築與規劃，認識設計背後的價值觀，令人思考城市綠化與氣候變化等未來挑戰。. 【旅遊達人同你傾】墨西哥遊歷魔法小鎮仙人掌高過人. 旅遊記者洪慧冰早前在拉丁美洲旅居一年半，單是墨西哥便留了半年，從北到南遊遍火山、沙漠、美墨邊境、現代化首都、多個魔法小鎮……. 旅程過後，她最懷念墨西哥美食，包括Tacos以及各地各有不同的粟米餅類食物、各種衝擊味蕾的辣椒、餘韻強勁的甜酸甘Mole醬等，難忘的還有本地團遇上的熱情墨西哥人、一起遊歷的西班牙文同學、好客的當地人……. 主持：Jumbo曾淑雅. 嘉賓主持：洪慧冰.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: According to the Hong Kong Samaritans' 2023 suicide statistics, there were 1,092 suicide deaths, with 711 male cases—the highest in a decade. Males outnumbered females in suicide rates. Societal expectations place immense pressure on men, which continues to grow. Hong Kong’s latest life expectancy data shows men live 82.5 years, five years less than women’s 87.9. Men’s stress and mental health involve complex social, economic, and cultural factors. Addressing this requires societal support, shifting traditional norms, providing mental health resources, and promoting healthier lifestyles.(n)

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Traces of fascinating animals at Lung Fu Shan
programme.desc: Located in the Central and Western District of Hong Kong, Lung Fu Shan is a mountain peak that stands at an elevation of 253 meters. It wasn't until 1998 that the government officially designated the surrounding area as Lung Fu Shan Country Park, which is also the smallest country park in Hong Kong. . Despite its small size, Lung Fu Shan Country Park is full of character. For instance, the park features the historic Pinewood Battery, which is listed as a Grade II historic buildings in Hong Kong and serves as a reminder of Battle of Hong Kong history during the past. . In addition to its cultural heritage, the park is also rich in ecological diversity. The streams within the park are home to various organisms, including freshwater prawns and stream crabs. By observing carefully, visitors may also spot traces of wildlife such as porcupines, masked palm civets, and short-nosed fruit bats within the park.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 佛羅里達州 - 另一個荷里活
programme.desc: 《音樂旅人》前往荷里活，不過並非滿街電影明星片場的那個，我們要探索的那個城市，同樣名叫「荷里活」，位於佛羅里達洲。佛羅里達州經常被其南方的耀眼鄰居邁亞密海灘遮蓋了光芒，但這裡的荷里活要世界知道，它自有特色之處吸引遊客，以音樂說故事，同時建立更強大的社區。我們發覺無論去世界上任何地方，只要略為發掘一下，總會發現到豐富的音樂寶庫。我們在佛羅里達州荷里活的時候，適逢西班牙探險家環龐斯德利昂來佛五百週年，西班牙天王級巨星安東里奧卡莫納也在參與慶典，我們與他傾談，看他演出；我們又和從音樂中找到靈感的壁畫藝術家李珀見面，到訪古巴雪茄店，訪問本地音樂人艾廸巴爾佐拉，也到了美國最高檔齊全的鼓店見識。旅途中我們嘗試了荷里活美食，享用海灘美景以及精彩夜生活。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月1日 星期二晚，10時30分 Music Voyager heads to Hollywood. Not the one with movie stars and film studios, we're exploring the other city called Hollywood. .in Florida. Hollywood, Florida is often overshadowed by its flashier neighbor to the south, Miami Beach. Yet this Hollywood has been letting the world know that it has something special to offer visitors and it is using music to tell its story…and build a stronger community at the same time. We've always been fascinated by the ways in which you can visit almost anyplace in the world and with a little digging find a harvest of musical riches. Our adventures in Hollywood, Florida include a conversation and performance with Spanish superstar Antonio Carmona who is in town for the Viva Florida 500 concert commemorating the arrival of Spanish explorer Ponce de Leon, a chat with renowned music-inspired muralist and painter Lebo, a Cuban cigar bar escapade with local musician Eddie Balzola and a visit to Resurrection Drums, one of the country’s premier drum shops. Along the way we discover Hollywood’s cuisine, beaches and thriving nightlife. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.1 TUE 10:30pm.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 佛羅里達州邁阿密 - 魔幻之城
programme.desc: 邁阿密這個城市，每個人都認得，真正懂得的卻很少。對於這城的熣燦霓虹燈光、滿佈型格度假酒店的黃金海灘，大家都不會陌生，不過這城市的脈搏，卻是藏於住在其中的多元種族文化社區。我們發掘了強勁明亮的邁阿密電子舞曲，也有幸欣賞其拉丁海地曲風，先後和阿福羅貝塔、斯帕姆群星、T-VICE以及「為珍發狂」等歌手組合見面分享。旅程中我們暢飲古巴咖啡，踏單車遊遍色彩繽紛的壁畫藝術區，吃嚇人的哥倫比亞熱狗，享受這城日夜不斷的創意活力。邁阿密鮮為人知的一面，即將為你揭開。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月1日 星期二晚，11時00分 Miami is a city that everyone recognizes but few truly know. We’re familiar with its neon glow and beaches lined with golden sands and art deco hotels, but the heartbeat of the city lies in the vibrant multi-cultural communities that call this city home. We explore the fiery sounds of Miami’s electronic dance music scene as well as its Latin and Haitian grooves, with Afrobeta, The Spam All Stars, T-Vice and Locos Por Juana. We get buzzed on Cuban coffee, tour the colorful mural district by bike and take on the daunting Colombian hot dog, enjoying the spontaneous creativity and color that keeps the city pulsing day and night. This is Miami like you have never seen, or heard, before. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.1 TUE 11:00pm.(n)

programme.title: 太陽計劃2025創科夢啟「杭」
programme.sub-title: 太陽計劃 2025 #1: 探索未來
programme.desc: 今集帶你跟著太陽使者暢遊杭州，探索這座城市的科技與文化魅力！. 太陽使者走訪標誌性地標未來科技城、電商巨頭阿里巴巴，以及杭州六小龍之一的強腦科技，感受杭州作為科技重鎮的創新活力。又會參訪杭州國家版本館，領略中華文化的精髓。. 這趟旅程不只是探險，更是太陽使者的成長之旅，他們從中學習創新的思維，激發靈感，想知道杭州如何從江南水鄉變身全球科技焦點？太陽使者在這場科技與文化之旅中的獨特體驗？記得留意《太陽計劃－創科夢啟『杭』》和太陽使者一起開啟這段精彩旅程.(n)

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第四集曹星如/跑者背後. 〈跑者愛分享〉－曹星如. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與「神奇小子」曹星如（Rex）從紅隧口跑到中環摩天輪，探索港島海濱的熱門打卡點！Rex分享他在拳擊與跑步的共同領悟，強調呼吸節奏的重要性，慢下來才能更好地收放自如。昔日孤身擂臺的他，如今與Inez奔跑中並肩暢談：「無論擂台或跑道，努力付出超越自己進步！」. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－做好擺手，可免受傷？. 跑步不只是腳步，擺手姿勢也很重要！錯誤的擺手容易造成膝蓋與關節受傷。正確方法是雙臂貼近身體，上擺至胸口、下擺至腰部，像鐘擺般前後擺動。搭配彈力帶訓練，強化肌肉力量，跑得更安全、更有效率！. 〈跑者背後〉. 香港跑界流傳一句金句：「無獎都要有相！」每場跑步比賽背後，都有賴大量義工通力合作，更少不了攝影師沿途為跑手捕捉珍貴的回憶。作為跑步義工的蘇永權，以及經營跑步相片平台的林志倫，他們究竟如何投入這些幕後工作，默默為跑壇貢獻呢.(n)

programme.title: 優遊記精華遊
programme.desc: 粗獷主義建築以其裸露的結構、粗糙的材料和強烈的幾何形態，在二十世紀建築設計中別樹一幟。建築師兼攝影師麥憬淮與主持Kay李凱翹邊走邊說，漫遊赤柱聖士提反書院及香港中文大學，以建築師的專業視角與攝影師的細膩觀察，帶大家細味粗獷建築的設計特色、空間美學及背後的故事.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第六十一集 - 跟光影玩遊戲
programme.desc: BobieLand 第六十一集-跟光影玩遊戲. 編導:蔡頌詩. 園長澔天哥哥、寶欣姐姐、小隊長Mika 、Jamie和Okie Bobie在商量BobieLand新計劃，決定為BobieLand打造一個新地標，放置一枝具代表性的燈柱在廣場中間，並決定由管理員Okie Bobie 做總設計師。. 【故事時間】「小明」. 今集負責講故事的是園長Kevin哥哥，這次他揀選了一本奇幻的繪本「小明」，故事的主角就是一個盡忠職守的小燈泡，一切就從一個士多房說起…直到有一天，小明跌進一個空洞的夢境…. 【冷知識】. programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.sub-title: 鍾意食「細蓉」的緬甸阿哥
programme.desc: 31歲的 Sai Htong Kham溫文爾雅，一派學者風範。他來自緬甸，自稱「佛教徒」，但會喝酒吃肉，只是更喜歡追求靈性與精神生活。十年前，Kham從緬甸來到香港讀大學，之後唸碩士、做研究助理，現在是博士研究生，十年都在學術的「象牙塔」中度過。. Kham感謝香港開拓了他的眼界，將他從昔日緬甸的窮鄉僻壤帶到現代化的國際都市。他也學會了回饋，加入了一個幫助難民的民間機構，在繁忙的學術生涯中為他們提供協助。初到香港的頭幾年，Kham很不習慣，這裏很少緬甸人，也找不到家鄉的餐廳，每次回國探望父母之後都不願回來。但現在香港確實他的家園，他強調是家園，不是第二家園。他掛念這裏的「細蓉」雲吞面、便利、人情世故，每次到海外參加學術會議都想儘快趕回來。. 大部分緬甸人都是彿教徒。生活在香港，Kham喜歡逛廟宇，在香火繚繞之處找到清淨與精神的滿足。從緬甸來到香港，Kham需要物質生活也渴望靈性的追求，他在這裡找到了這種共融的可能。. 今集主持愛美Omme和吳.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：秦川通過血指紋鎖定疑兇
programme.desc: 秦川被調往緒城市擔任市局刑偵支隊支隊長。東萍縣公安局局長緊急前來請求秦川去指導辦案一宗五年未破的婦女兒童被殺案。由於證據鏈不夠完整，犯罪嫌疑人兩次被收押後都釋放了。秦川要求拿出案子的副卷，發現當中有半枚血指紋，便找來專家曹忠恕鑑別，兇手原來另有其人.(n)

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 2023年一個夏天，一隻貓bb突然出現在中學走廊。路過的同學立即找老師幫忙救起貓貓，並把貓貓命名為「柚子」。學校為此成立貓舍，並同時領養「大眼妹」和「三花」兩隻貓貓，三隻貓貓從此化身為貓老師，為一眾師生上了生命的一課.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 – 大自然奧秘
programme.desc: 植物佔地球所有生物總重量超過95%，堪稱陸地覇主。雖然植物看似靜止無聲，但其實擁有敏銳的感測器，能感知環境，與其他植物甚至動物溝通。尖端科學正把植物如「童話世界」般的神奇能力揭開，透過高科技影像與視覺特效，你可以在節目中看到植物怎樣「交談」，互相通報危險，召喚昆蟲和鳥兒來幫手…. 這個人類從未真正了解的植物世界，正挑戰我們對自然法則的認知.(n)

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 做人當然應該合乎「仁義道德」，但竟然亦都有人認為「厚顏無恥」、「黑心無情」是古代英雄豪傑的致勝關鍵。二十世紀初，思想家李宗吾提出「厚黑學」，寫出對自古以來成功人士的反思。運用「厚黑學」，是否真的可以加速達至成功呢？. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 蕭欣浩(大學講師). 吳沚默(作者、編劇). #厚黑學#厚顏無恥#黑心無情#成功反思#學人沙龍.(n)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：不是驚喜就是驚嚇
programme.desc: 馮蔚然和程回聊起女朋友和好兄弟之間的區別，程回從字眼間分析，蔣時延一開始對唐漾就不單純是兄弟的情感，而馮蔚然卻不以為然。甘一鳴把唐漾叫到了辦公室，質問她是不是故意拖延青籟培訓的貸款申請，唐漾直言不諱.(n)

programme.title: 同唱友誼歌─2025中越金曲音樂盛典
programme.sub-title: 同唱友誼歌─2025中越金曲音樂盛典
programme.desc: 同唱友誼歌─2025中越金曲音樂盛典在越南河內舉行，由廣西廣播電視局、廣西廣播電視台、越南之聲廣播電台及香港電台聯合主辦。在活動現場，中越藝術家們或激昂澎湃或婉轉深情的真摯演繹，將現場氣氛推向高潮。. 今年適逢「同唱友誼歌」中越音樂交流活動發起二十周年，作為中越人文交流的重要平台之一，通過藝術發生共鳴共振，推動兩國人民之間的「心相通」.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第六十一集 - 跟光影玩遊戲
programme.desc: BobieLand 第六十一集-跟光影玩遊戲. 編導:蔡頌詩. 園長澔天哥哥、寶欣姐姐、小隊長Mika 、Jamie和Okie Bobie在商量BobieLand新計劃，決定為BobieLand打造一個新地標，放置一枝具代表性的燈柱在廣場中間，並決定由管理員Okie Bobie 做總設計師。. 【故事時間】「小明」. 今集負責講故事的是園長Kevin哥哥，這次他揀選了一本奇幻的繪本「小明」，故事的主角就是一個盡忠職守的小燈泡，一切就從一個士多房說起…直到有一天，小明跌進一個空洞的夢境…. 【冷知識】. Wheel仔和花哩碌為甜CC慶生，二人不停審問甜CC，但甜CC堅持不說出年齡的秘密。花哩碌乘機介紹全世界最「大年紀」的燈膽，原來已經117歲，並且已列入健力士世界紀錄「世界最長壽的電燈膽」，到底甜CC 有沒有屈服呢.(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師想為賽思畫一幅肖像，無奈她總是忙碌無暇當模特兒。尋古大師帶領我們展開一場鉛筆歷史的時空之旅，從史前時代的炭筆雛形到現代的精緻鉛筆。在每個時代，他都會遇到不同版本的賽思。但他無法畫下她的肖像，決定憑記憶刻畫她的肖像….(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師以時裝設計師的身份，展示了一系列褲的時裝作品。記者彼德對他進行訪問，指出褲並非一向如今日所見的模樣。尋古大師引領我們探索褲的奇特歷史，並講述女性爭取穿著褲的權利所經歷的奮鬥歷程.(n)

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：袁父隱瞞袁歌獨自入院
programme.desc: 杜秉文告訴谷嶠接下來公司的重心會放在Lisa上，谷嶠知道其實袁歌其實更看好姝美的平價市場，想要幫助袁歌。杜秉文提醒谷嶠可以往聯名方向考慮一下。袁歌的父親回家，袁父說自己很後悔當時沒有照顧好袁歌和媽媽。隔天，留下一張紙條然後走了。其實袁父在醫院住院.(n)

南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：姚玉玲向汪新表白
programme.desc: 姚玉玲表白汪新，汪新也承認自己喜歡姚玉玲，兩人在一起。汪新稍感彆扭，想暫時隱瞞關係，姚玉玲同意。馬魁妻子暈倒，汪父把她送到醫院。王素芳強求大夫隱瞞病情，說服醫生幫忙隱瞞。汪永革和汪新希望留下照顧馬魁妻子，被馬魁拒絕。馬魁話裡有話，讓汪新產生懷疑.(n)

programme.title: 南來北往
programme.desc: 馬魁聊到老瞎子走丟的閨女，表示一定幫助老瞎子找到閨女，老瞎子表示感謝。火車上竊盜集團又耍新花樣，以魔術吸引乘客注意，幫助同伙偷盜。馬魁上前欲抓人時讓主犯逃跑。汪新跟上，意欲抓獲主犯時，主犯把錢包扔地上，假裝撿到錢包，並自殘誣陷汪新動手.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第六十二集 - 跟光影玩遊戲
programme.desc: BobieLand 第六十二集-跟光影玩遊戲. 編導:蔡頌詩. 園長澔天哥哥、寶欣姐姐、小隊長Mika 、Jamie和Okie Bobie開會討論地標燈柱設計，眾人在幻想燈柱旁邊會有人彈結他自彈自唱、有人會跳街舞、有人會裝飾聖誕裝飾、有人會約會朋友或情侶，大家也在期待BobieLand燈柱剪綵儀式。. 【故事時間】「小明」. 上集說到，小明突然天旋地轉，感到頭暈暈，原來有人將它從天花板擰下來。小狗擔著小明去到一個全新地方，小明覺得很新奇，在美麗的夜空，突然有流星飛過，小明許了一個願，之後就進入夢鄉。醒來後，小明看見一個世界上最大最光的「失散兄弟」，從此令它懂得自己的渺小，卻有很大的存在價值。. 此外，澔天哥哥和小隊長Jamie教大家做一個馬賽克玻璃燈.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：我們沒幹過的事情
programme.desc: 唐漾、蔣時延一問才知，程回就住在這棟公寓，程回邀兩人回家小歇，得知蔣時延要租房子，便邀請蔣時延隨時隨地都能來自己家住，蔣時延只能尷尬笑笑.(n)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 牛奶好味又有益，可以飲用之餘，又是一種百搭的食材。今集「識食專員」奧米會去中山一個乳牛體驗農場，學習擠牛奶的技巧，又可以一嚐新鮮牛奶的滋味。回到廚房，廚師Mabel設計了一個健康版炒牛奶，仿如綻放的花，更請來中大醫學院院長趙偉仁教授以其嶺南畫派的造詣，即席為菜式畫龍點睛。. 主持：鄭萃雯(Karen)、Mabel Ho. 嘉賓：趙偉仁教授(香港中文大學醫學院院長).(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十二集：李艾姦殺案終被偵破
programme.desc: 五年後，秦川去到淞山縣辦理一宗久偵未破的姦殺積案。秦川仔細研究了案情，認為這個案子有生物物證，可以利用DNA來破案。秦川求助省廳物證鑒定中心卻得不出頭緒，物證中心主任雷修平決定換國際前沿技術再試，結果在樣本中鎖定了疑犯，案件終得以偵破.(n)

programme.title: 念
programme.desc: 器官捐贈微電影《念》，講述一位母親為離世兒子捐出器官時，所經歷嘅思念與抉擇，以及捐出兒子器官後，見證到受贈者與家屬重獲新生而萌生的全新體會。希望透過微電影鼓勵大眾踏出重要一步，支持器官捐贈，讓受贈者及他們的家人得到第二人生.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 4
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay 和他的女兒Tilly前往西班牙加利西亞，探索當地滿載特色的烹飪傳統，這個經常被忽略的西班牙角落，不單風景秀麗，更是西班牙的美食瑰寶，出產各種優質海鮮、獲獎芝士、優質牛肉等等。. 為搜集美味食材，在加利西亞期間，Gordon 跑到海岸在大風大浪之下採集狗爪螺。父女二人又走到青口養殖浮台，收集當地人自豪地形容為世界上最美味的青口，並到農場學習製作一款得奬芝士。最後在廚藝比拼中，兩父女迎戰加利西亞星級名廚Pepe Vieira 的父子檔.(n)

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：我們沒幹過的事情
programme.desc: 唐漾、蔣時延一問才知，程回就住在這棟公寓，程回邀兩人回家小歇，得知蔣時延要租房子，便邀請蔣時延隨時隨地都能來自己家住，蔣時延只能尷尬笑笑.(n)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 牛奶好味又有益，可以飲用之餘，又是一種百搭的食材。今集「識食專員」奧米會去中山一個乳牛體驗農場，學習擠牛奶的技巧，又可以一嚐新鮮牛奶的滋味。回到廚房，廚師Mabel設計了一個健康版炒牛奶，仿如綻放的花，更請來中大醫學院院長趙偉仁教授以其嶺南畫派的造詣，即席為菜式畫龍點睛。. 主持：鄭萃雯(Karen)、Mabel Ho. 嘉賓：趙偉仁教授(香港中文大學醫學院院長).(n)

programme.title: 森動香港
programme.desc: 今集回顧香港植樹歷史，從參觀香港植物標本室收藏的百年前樹木標本，檢視城市老照片中的路邊樹，再到香港郊野公園的大棠苗圃，認識郊野公園的植林歷史，繼而展望未來的植林研究方案，理解原來每棵樹木背後都是無數人，經年累月，默默耕耘的成果.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第六十二集 - 跟光影玩遊戲
programme.desc: BobieLand 第六十二集-跟光影玩遊戲. 編導:蔡頌詩. 園長澔天哥哥、寶欣姐姐、小隊長Mika 、Jamie和Okie Bobie開會討論地標燈柱設計，眾人在幻想燈柱旁邊會有人彈結他自彈自唱、有人會跳街舞、有人會裝飾聖誕裝飾、有人會約會朋友或情侶，大家也在期待BobieLand燈柱剪綵儀式。. 【故事時間】「小明」. 上集說到，小明突然天旋地轉，感到頭暈暈，原來有人將它從天花板擰下來。小狗擔著小明去到一個全新地方，小明覺得很新奇，在美麗的夜空，突然有流星飛過，小明許了一個願，之後就進入夢鄉。醒來後，小明看見一個世界上最大最光的「失散兄弟」，從此令它懂得自己的渺小，卻有很大的存在價值。. 此外，澔天哥哥和小隊長Jamie教大家做一個馬賽克玻璃燈.(n)

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：谷嶠和鄭宴熙競爭簽取合同
programme.desc: 袁父完成手術，袁歌在病房陪著袁父。袁歌怕杜秉文出差分心，沒有告訴他自己父親要手術的事。旁邊病床孫阿姨的兒子孫斌每天幫忙照顧袁父，袁父對孫斌很滿意。谷嶠去跟著名的國漫畫家談版權，卻發現鄭宴熙已經到了，她處處和谷嶠競爭及攬功.(n)
